Som senior fullstackutvecklare utvecklar och vidareutvecklar du system som används i produktion. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från teknisk analys och systemdesign till implementation, test och produktionssättning.

* Utveckla backendtjänster och API:er i Java eller .NET och C#
* Bygga frontend med React, Angular eller Next.js och TypeScript
* Utveckla och drifta lösningar i Azure
* Arbeta med CI/CD, GitHub Actions och Infrastructure as Code
* Integrera system, databaser och externa tjänster
* Bidra till systemdesign, cloudarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Arbeta med observability, prestanda och stabilitet

**Tekniker och arbetssätt**


Relevanta tekniker och områden är:

* Java eller .NET och C#
* React, Angular eller Next.js
* TypeScript
* Azure och Azure-tjänster
* CI/CD och GitHub Actions
* Terraform
* Oracle, PL/SQL och PostgreSQL
* API:er och systemintegrationer
* Cloudarkitektur och observability
* AI och Large Language Models


Vi förväntar oss inte att du kan allt i listan. Du behöver ha en tydlig backendprofil inom antingen Java eller .NET och erfarenhet av minst en av frontendteknikerna.

**Vi söker dig som**

* Har minst fem års professionell erfarenhet som utvecklare
* Har Java eller .NET och C# som din huvudsakliga backendteknik
* Har erfarenhet av API:er, backendtjänster och integrationer
* Har arbetat med React, Angular eller Next.js
* Har erfarenhet av TypeScript
* Har arbetat med Azure eller andra cloudbaserade lösningar
* Har erfarenhet av CI/CD och DevOps
* Förstår systemdesign och vad som krävs för att bygga stabila lösningar i produktion
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska eller engelska
* Kan arbeta på plats i Malmö fem dagar i veckan


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av flera frontendramverk, containerbaserade och distribuerade system samt Infrastructure as Code med Terraform. Erfarenhet av observability, AI-integrationer med LLM och konsultuppdrag är också värdefull.


För den här tjänsten kan vi inte erbjuda sponsring av eller hjälp med arbetstillstånd. Du behöver därför redan ha rätt att arbeta i Sverige.

**Om Knowit Core Malmö**


Knowit Core Malmö består av cirka 120 kollegor inom bland annat systemutveckling, arkitektur, projektledning och design. Vi arbetar i mindre team och nära våra ledare, med utrymme för både specialister och bredare tekniska profiler.


Vi erbjuder:

* Kundprojekt inom systemutveckling, cloud och digitala plattformar
* Kompetensutveckling inom backend, frontend, cloud, DevOps och AI
* Workshops och kunskapsutbyte med andra specialister
* En trygg anställning med kollektivavtal och fast månadslön
* Ett centralt kontor vid Stortorget i Malmö


Vill du arbeta som senior fullstackutvecklare med Java eller .NET och bygga stabila lösningar som används i produktion? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

**Om Knowit**  

Knowit är ett nordiskt konsultbolag som hjälper företag, myndigheter och organisationer att lyckas i den digitala transformationen. Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.


Vi är cirka 3 700 medarbetare och arbetar genom våra affärsområden Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight och Products – främst i Norden, men även i Polen, Serbien och Tyskland.

**We don’t wait for the future. We build it.**

title: Senior Systemutvecklare
description:
**Om oss**  

På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov.


Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad.


Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder.  

  

**Arbetsbeskrivning**  

En svensk offentlig myndighet med en omfattande IT-verksamhet söker två seniora systemutvecklare med agil profil.


IT-organisationen ansvarar för den IT som används av myndighetens medarbetare och har ett helhetsansvar för nyutveckling, förvaltning och stöd av digitala verktyg, applikationer och register. Syftet är att säkerställa att verksamheten har ändamålsenliga och effektiva IT-system som stödjer myndighetens kärnuppdrag.


Den aktuella verksamheten utvecklar och förvaltar ett antal system och register som stödjer myndighetens operativa verksamhet. Uppdraget omfattar modernisering och vidareutveckling av centrala register- och verksamhetssystem.

**Teknisk miljö**
-----------------


Arbetet bedrivs huvudsakligen inom tekniska plattformar baserade på:

* Linux
* MySQL
* Oracle
* Spring Boot
* JBoss
* Java


Integrationer mellan systemen och kringliggande system sker bland annat med hjälp av:

* JMS (Java Message Service)
* SOAP
* RESTful Web Services


Utvecklingsmiljön är huvudsakligen Windowsbaserad.


Arbetet utförs på plats i myndighetens lokaler, med möjlighet till hemarbete maximalt två dagar per vecka.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------


Konsulten ska bland annat:

* Ta fram tekniska lösningar och bidra till vidareutveckling och förvaltning av befintliga system.
* Sätta upp och vidareutveckla utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Testa och leverera enligt teamets planering.
* Självständigt driva och ansvara för aktiviteter och leveranser.
* Arbeta agilt tillsammans med team, Scrum Master och uppdragsledare.
* Dela med sig av kunskap och bidra till kompetenshöjning hos mer juniora systemutvecklare.
* Samarbeta med andra uppdrag och team där beroenden finns.
* Kontinuerligt säkerställa att systemdokumentationen är aktuell och uppdaterad.

**Kvalificeringskrav – skallkrav**
----------------------------------

* Relevant eftergymnasial akademisk utbildning inom IT, alternativt motsvarande förvärvad erfarenhet som bedöms likvärdig.
* Minst 10 års erfarenhet av utveckling i Java.
* Minst 8 års erfarenhet av utveckling i Java EE.
* Minst 6 års erfarenhet av Java Spring Boot och utveckling i Spring.
* Minst 6 års erfarenhet av Docker/containers.
* Minst 8 års erfarenhet av arbete i agila team med arbetssätt som Scrum och Kanban.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

**Meriterande kompetens – börkrav**
-----------------------------------

* Erfarenhet av JavaScript och Angular.
* Erfarenhet av databaser såsom Oracle och MySQL.
* Erfarenhet av JBoss.
* Erfarenhet av Jenkins och CI/CD.
* Erfarenhet av testautomatisering.
* Erfarenhet av projekthanteringsverktyg såsom JIRA.
* Erfarenhet av processer och arbetssätt inom större offentlig verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom rättsväsendet eller annan samhällsviktig verksamhet.

**Personliga egenskaper**
-------------------------


Personliga egenskaper värderas högt. Konsulten förväntas:

* Se kunskapsdelning som en naturlig del av uppdraget.
* Vara prestigelös och hjälpsam.
* Vara en lättsam lagspelare som bidrar till ett gott samarbetsklimat.
* Ha helhetsperspektiv och hålla gruppens pågående arbete inom både förvaltning och nyutveckling i fokus.

**Uppdragsperiod**
------------------

* **Start:** 28 december 2026 eller snarast möjligt efter godkänd registerkontroll.
* **Slut:** 28 december 2027.
* **Option:** Förlängning till 28 december 2028. Hela eller delar av optionsperioden kan komma att nyttjas.  

  

**Ansökan**  

När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder.


Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

title: Senior AI Developer - LLM Integration
description:
We are looking for Senior AI Developers who build production-grade solutions on top of large language models. Our clients are moving AI from experiments into daily operations, and they need engineers who can take an idea all the way to a reliable, monitored system.


You will integrate LLMs into existing tools, pipelines and business processes, design evaluation and quality controls, and help teams understand what current models can and cannot do. Assignments typically combine hands-on engineering with advising on scope, feasibility and risk.

* AI-assisted developer tooling, such as code review, merge support or test generation
* Automated analysis of logs, incidents or documents with suggested actions
* Shared AI infrastructure for evaluation, monitoring and safe rollout

  

**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Strong Python skills
* Proven experience deploying LLM-based systems to production, including prompt engineering and evaluation
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and version control
* Experience designing for failure handling and human review of AI output
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Based in or able to work on site in the Stockholm area on a hybrid basis

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with C++, C# or other compiled languages
* Experience with RAG, agents, tool use or multi-step LLM workflows
* Model fine-tuning or self-hosted models
* Cloud experience (Azure, AWS or GCP)
* Data engineering experience
* Experience from game development, Perforce, Jenkins or Unreal Engine

title: Utvecklare lärspel, Eskilstuna
description:
Om företaget
  
Skolplus AB utvecklar digitala läromedel för grundskolan, upp till årskurs 6. Vårt motto är ”Lärande med glädje”, vilket tar sig uttryck i roliga kunskapsspel, smarta lärverktyg och utskriftsmaterial. Allt ingår i vår webbplats skolplus.se som säljs som en prenumerationstjänst till skolor och privatpersoner. Vi har idag över 90 % av Sveriges grundskolor som kunder, vilket troligen gör oss till den mest spridda webbtjänsten för svenska skolan. Det vi skapar används och gör skillnad för undervisningen ute i skolorna. Kontoret ligger i centrala Eskilstuna och består idag av sju medarbetare. Tack vare den mindre arbetsgruppen har du som anställd stora möjligheter att vara med och påverka det dagliga arbetet.
  
Arbetsbeskrivning
  
Vi söker en programmerare som vill bygga nästa generation lärspel och digitala övningar på skolplus.se. Du kommer att utveckla nya spel och interaktiva övningar från idé till färdig funktion, samt förbättra och vidareutveckla det vi redan har.
  
Du arbetar nära vårt team och bidrar till att spelet blir pedagogiskt, roligt och tekniskt hållbart. En viktig del av rollen är att använda AI som ett verktyg i både utveckling och idégenerering – till exempel för att snabbare ta fram prototyper, innehåll, grafikunderlag eller kod – utan att släppa kontrollen över kvalitet och pedagogik.
  
Du ska kunna visa konkreta exempel på vad du har byggt tidigare, gärna spel, interaktiva övningar eller liknande webbapplikationer.
  
Kvalifikationer
  
  

**Vi söker dig som har:**  

Erfarenhet av webbutveckling med HTML, JavaScript och CSS
  
Vana att använda AI i det praktiska utvecklingsarbetet (kod, prototyper, innehåll, bilder eller liknande)
  
Förmåga att visa upp exempel på tidigare arbete (live-demo eller liknande)
  
Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och i team
  
Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet
  
God problemlösningsförmåga och vilja att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verktyg och teknologier
  
  

Meriterande är erfarenhet av spelutveckling, interaktiva läromedel eller liknande pedagogiska produkter.
  
Övrig information
  
**Start:** Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse.
  
**Omfattning:** Heltid, tillsvidare med 6 månaders provanställning.
  
**Placering:** Vårt kontor, Eskilsgatan 20, Eskilstuna.
  
**Övrigt:** Lön efter överenskommelse, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag.
  
Ansökan
  
Ansökan senast 23 oktober 2026 till jobb@skolplus.se
  
Obs! Jobbet är ej distans. Om du inte är bosatt i Eskilstuna kommun, ange om du planerar att pendla till jobbet eller att flytta.
  
Skicka din ansökan, CV och exempel på tidigare arbete till jobb@skolplus.se. Ansökningar behandlas löpande.

title: ServiceNow Developer

title: Senior UX Designer / Frontendutvecklare
description:
I den här rollen kombinerar du UX-design med utveckling och arbetar tillsammans med kreativa kollegor för att skapa engagerande och välfungerande digitala användarupplevelser.

Vi söker dig som har en stark grund inom UX och samtidigt trivs nära tekniken och har kunskap inom kod och webbutveckling. * Samla in, paketera och omsätta användar- och kundinsikter
* Arbeta med skiss- och prototypverktyg som Figma
* Driva workshops

* Samarbeta nära utvecklare och förstå de tekniska förutsättningarna för en design
* Arbeta med kod, exempelvis HTML, CSS och JavaScript, på en nivå där du kan ta designen närmare en fungerande lösning
* Använda dig av AI i design- och utvecklingsprocessen


Meriterande är om du:

* Är certifierad inom tillgänglighet

Du erbjuds en trygg anställning med kollektivavtal, generösa och proaktiva hälso- och friskvårdsupplägg samt pensions- och försäkringsförmåner. Du blir en del av Knowit Experience – där vi skapar datadrivna kundresor och digitala upplevelser som stärker varumärken och affärer. Häng med oss och forma framtidens kundupplevelser i Norden.

**We don’t wait for the future. We build it.**

* Take ownership of product quality and performance
* Collaborate closely with designers and your product team to turn technical and business needs into solutions
* Work across team boundaries, in some engagements our backend sits with another party, which calls for close daily communication
* Take initiative and make sound decisions independently, while knowing when to bring in the right person

**Who you are**
---------------


Are you ready to make this role your own? **You might recognise yourself if you:**

* Have around 3–4 years of professional experience building native Android apps in Kotlin and Compose
* Have shipped at least one app to the Play Store and are comfortable releasing and maintaining an app in production
* Communicate well and are comfortable translating technical and business needs into working solutions together with a product team
* Are self-driven, take ownership of your work, and know when to ask for input
* Are curious about AI-assisted and agentic development, and enjoy using AI tools actively and thoughtfully in your everyday work

**About Framna**
----------------

**Framna means ‘to bring forward’ in Old Norse. And that is exactly what we do. We partner with industry leaders (and those about to be) to create excellent digital products that define markets, reshape industries, and deliver meaningful impact.**

**Born from the union of digital agencies Bontouch, Move, and Shape, Framna emerged from a strong, product-led culture. Today, over 600 of us collaborate across 11 studios in Denmark, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, and the US.**

**Every day, millions of users around the world rely on the products we help shape. From seamless payments to daily commutes, from better health management to smarter shopping. Our work supports more than €150 million in daily transactions and consistently earns an average App Store rating of 4.5.**

**Together with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, including Essity, SJ, Swish, SEB, and Vattenfall, we craft products that lead markets and push boundaries. Because when products win, businesses win. We call it Win by product.**

**What you get**
----------------

* **A role with real impact.** You will play a key role in shaping Framna’s growth by developing our most important partnerships and expanding how we work together.
* **A culture of curiosity.** A culture of curiosity. We have weekly Friday demos, and different communities across the company where people meet up, share knowledge, and dig into topics they're interested in together. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there's something new we want to explore.
* **The freedom to follow your “what if.”** We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you are curious about something, you will have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.
* **Teammates who bring their whole selves.** Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.
* **And of course, the benefits you’d expect.** A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

* Recruiter videocall
* First interview
* Case assignment
* Technical interview
* Reference check

**Please note:** we're office first, with our **Stockholm studio** as our main hub for demos, fika, and everyday collaboration, mixed with the freedom to work from home when it makes sense. You need to be based in Stockholm or within commuting distance. Unfortunately we're not able to offer relocation.


We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to learning more about you!

title: Operations Developer
description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.
**Om oss**


Gruppen Anläggningsstrategi är en del av avdelningen Anläggningsstyrning inom Lokalnätet. Enkelt sagt står Anläggningsstyrning för vårt "hur” och ”vad" och våra kollegor runtom i landet för "att" det blir gjort. Tillsammans med enheterna och samarbetspartners ska vi bygga, utveckla och underhålla lokalnätet för våra ca 1 miljon kunder och det är en självklarhet att detta ska göras på det säkraste och mest hållbara sättet möjligt.




**Din roll**


Vi söker nu två personer som kommer jobba med vår investering- och förvaltningsstrategi och säkerställa att dessa bryts ner i aktiviteter som bidrar till våra långsiktiga mål - tekniskt, ekonomiskt och hållbart.




Du följer kontinuerligt upp, analyserar och identifierar behov av justeringar i våra investeringar, med fokus på att de ligger i linje med tekniska riktlinjer, risknivåer och övergripande strategi. Rollen är datadriven och analytisk, med stor möjlighet att påverka vad vi investerar i – och när.

  

I rollen ingår även att:  



* Tillsammans med våra experter och specialister genomföra utvärdering av befintliga och nya komponenter för att hitta förbättringar ur ett kostnads- eller hållbarhetsperspektiv.
* Samverka så att våra processer och investerings- och förvaltningsstrategi går i linje med varandra.
* Samverka så att våra entreprenörer kan utföra arbete i linje med vår strategi både när det gäller att bygga likväl som underhåll.
* Samverka brett inom organisationen kring tekniska vägval, prioriteringar och långsiktiga åtgärdsplaner

  

Tjänsten innebär resande i begränsad omfattning.  



**Dina erfarenheter**


Vi söker dig som är genuint intresserad av teknik och har en erfarenhet inom elnätsbranschen eller annan infrastrukturnära bransch. Vi ser gärna att du har en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning, men är inte ett krav om du har erfarenhet inom branschen. Du har arbetat i roller som innebär exempelvis analys, projekt eller förvaltning, arbetsuppgifter du utför med nyfikenhet, struktur och genom samarbete. Arbetet kommer innebära samverkan i nationella och globala samarbeten i olika grupper över hela E.ON.


Eftersom rollen innebär mycket samverkan med såväl kollegor, entreprenörer som samarbetspartners, söker vi dig som har ett smidigt kommunikationssätt och kan skapa intresse hos dina mottagare. Vi behöver arbeta som ett för att verkligen lyckas med den här omställningen – vi blir bättre tillsammans!  



**Hur är det hos oss?**


Magnus Bengtsson kommer att bli din närmaste chef. Han har ett ledarskap där dina och teamets idéer styr arbetsgången samt där kulturen präglas av förtroende och tillit. Teamets välmående och utveckling är en förutsättning för att vi ska lyckas i vårt arbete. Med ett coachande förhållningssätt och stor tilltro till teamets förmåga leder han genom tydlig målstyrning, klara ansvarsområden och regelbunden uppföljning, där dialog och coaching är självklar del av vardagen.  



På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.


Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!

  

Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 4 oktober

title: Entry Level: Software Developer Integrated Sensing and Communication
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**About this opportunity**

  

Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) is an emerging technology area that combines wireless communication with sensing capabilities and will play an important role in the evolution toward 6G.  

At Ericsson, our vision is to create a world where limitless connectivity enhances lives, transforms businesses and contributes to a more sustainable future.

  

We are looking for newly graduated and early-career software engineers who want to build expertise in wireless technology, embedded software and real-time systems. Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will take increasing ownership of technical solutions, contribute to technical discussions and help influence the direction of our work.

  

Your contribution will focus on the Physical Layer (L1), with close interaction with the Scheduler (L2). This gives you the opportunity to build a broad understanding of real-time software, radio systems and how new functionality is developed into a product.

description:

-----------------



About this opportunity

  

Imagine joining a team at the moment when a new technology is still being shaped, where the questions are not all answered, the architecture is still evolving, and your work can influence how the solution is built and brought to market. That is the opportunity with Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), one of the emerging capabilities on the path toward 6G.

  

We are looking for newly graduated or early-career software engineers who want to help develop the baseband software that makes this possible. ISAC combines communication and sensing in the same radio network, opening new ways for mobile networks to understand the world around them while continuing to deliver high-performance connectivity. It is a technology area with potential to create significant impact for Ericsson, our customers and the future communication industry.

  

In this role, you will be part of Baseband Software in Lund, with a primary focus on L2 Scheduler. The scheduler decides how radio resources are used, how performance is balanced, and how new sensing capabilities can coexist with communication in a live network. For the right person, this is a chance to build deep technical expertise early, work close to real product development, and grow a career in an area that is highly relevant for Ericsson's future.

  

What you will do

  

You will be part of building Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication, ISAC, solution - a new domain that is expected to play an important role on the path toward 6G.

  

Together with the team, you will work across the full development flow, from early prestudies and technical exploration to system design, implementation, test, integration and end-to-end verification on node level.

  

You will join a team environment with a mix of newly recruited engineers and experienced colleagues. This gives you the opportunity to learn from people with deep knowledge of baseband software, radio access networks and real-time embedded development, while also contributing with new perspectives and modern ways of working.

  

You will


Develop high-quality ISAC software

  

Participate in prestudies, design, implementation, test and verification of new ISAC capabilities and future 6G-related functionality.

  

Explore how sensing and communication can coexist in the same radio network, including how radio resources, performance and system behavior are balanced.

  

Use agentic AI and modern AI-assisted development workflows to improve development speed, code quality, knowledge sharing and verification.

  

Contribute to learning how AI can support the product itself, as AI becomes an increasingly important part of future RAN and 6G solutions.

  

Work in a cross-functional and collaborative environment where teams take joint responsibility for delivering functionality end to end.

  

The skills you bring

  

Master of Science degree in a relevant area, or equivalent experience.

  

Programming knowledge in C and/or C++, with experience in Python, Java or similar languages as a plus.

  

Interest in software development for real products, preferably from studies, thesis work, internships or personal projects.

  

Curiosity about end-to-end system behavior, including how software runs, interacts and is verified in a complete node or network solution.

  

Familiarity with Linux, Git and modern AI-assisted development tools such as Kiro, Claude or similar is meriting.

  

We believe you have drive - an inner engine that makes you want to understand, improve and move things forward. You enjoy working in a team, sharing ideas and learning from others, while also being able to take responsibility and deliver independently when needed.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Energy Management Systems
description:
*Do you want to write backend code that actually matters, powering energy efficiency for thousands of buildings across Europe? Are you an experienced Java developer who takes end-to-end ownership, makes deliberate architectural choices, and wants real influence over a platform built on Azure and Kubernetes?*
*Then you might be the Senior Backend Developer our Mestro team in Stockholm is looking for!*
**As Part of the Department**
 We craft the vertical software of tomorrow, bringing sustainable impact to customers and society. At Mestro, we combine data-driven innovation with a genuine passion for energy efficiency and sustainability. As part of EG Group, we are a dedicated team of innovators and problem solvers who take responsibility for our contribution to our customers, each other, and the society we live in.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join Mestro on a permanent, full-time basis, contributing to the continued development of the platform. This is a hybrid role with our Stockholm office as your base. You will combine days on site with the team and days working remotely.
   

  

**Your Tasks: Design, Build, and Own the Backend**
 As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be one of the people the team relies on for the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will design and build new functionality, improve what we already have, and work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to turn business goals into technical solutions that hold up over time.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs for the Mestro platform.
* Drive architectural and technical decisions, and take responsibility for their consequences.
* Deploy, monitor, and operate applications in Azure and Kubernetes. You build it, you run it.
* Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues.
* Set the bar for code quality through well-tested code and constructive code reviews.
* Break down complex and unclear requirements together with product owners and turn them into solutions that can be delivered.
* Mentor colleagues and raise the level of the whole team, not just your own output.


**Your Profile: An Experienced Developer Who Takes Ownership**
 You have enough experience to know that writing the code is rarely the hard part. You make pragmatic trade-offs, communicate clearly about risk and scope, and take ownership of your work all the way into production. You want to work in a small team where your opinion carries weight, and where you are expected to have one.
   

  

**You Are The Ideal Candidate If You**
* Have 8-10 years of professional experience in backend development.
* Have deep knowledge of Java, and solid experience with MS SQL and Azure.
* Have hands-on experience building and running applications in Kubernetes.
* Have a strong grasp of software architecture and distributed systems, including the trade-offs they involve.
* Have experience mentoring developers and driving technical decisions in a team.
* Communicate confidently in English, both in writing and in technical discussion.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience designing and operating microservice architectures.
* Strong CI/CD and DevOps practices: pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability.
* Experience with large data volumes, time series data, or integrations with external data sources.
* Background in the energy management, proptech, or data analytics domain.


**What's in it for you?**
* A product with real purpose. Mestro helps buildings across Europe cut energy waste, so your code has tangible impact.
* Real technical influence. You will shape architecture and priorities, not just close tickets.
* A modern tech stack: Java, Azure, Kubernetes, MS SQL.
* Autonomy with support. We trust you to own your work, and we back you when you need it.
* A hybrid setup with our Stockholm office as your base, and a collaborative, low-ego culture.
* The stability and resources of EG Group behind a product team that still moves fast.
* Room to grow, whether deeper into architecture, DevOps, or domain expertise in energy management.


**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


**We look forward to hearing from you!**
 If you are interested in learning more before you apply, please contact Senior Manager Jimmy Persson jiper@eg.se or on +46 702 99 10 49. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

**Curious what it's really like to work at EG?**
 Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG
   

  

 See all our open positions here
   

  

 Learn more about EG here.

title: Android Developer
description:
**Are you the kind of Android developer who cares as much about how an app feels as how it's built? Framna is looking for an Android Developer to join our Stockholm studio.** 




  





**You'll build and maintain native Android apps as part of a cross-functional product team that shares that same drive and passion for building products people actually love to use.** 




  





**Become part of the team** 




 Framna partners with some of the world's most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across ten studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.
 



  





 As our next Android Developer, you'll join our team in Stockholm, working alongside designers, developers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first concept to real-world product. You'll also become part of Framna's wider Engineering team, where developers meet regularly to exchange knowledge and grow together.
 



  





**What you will do** 




 This is a role for someone who enjoys combining hands-on building with genuine care for quality. You'll work closely with your team to build, ship, and maintain Android features that are ready for real users.
 



  





**More specifically, you will:** 




  




* Build and maintain Android apps and features in production, using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
* Take ownership of product quality and performance
* Collaborate closely with designers and your product team to turn technical and business needs into solutions
* Work across team boundaries, in some engagements our backend sits with another party, which calls for close daily communication
* Take initiative and make sound decisions independently, while knowing when to bring in the right person



  





**Who you are** 




 Are you ready to make this role your own?
 **You might recognise yourself if you:** 




  




* Have around 3–4 years of professional experience building native Android apps in Kotlin and Compose
* Have shipped at least one app to the Play Store and are comfortable releasing and maintaining an app in production
* Communicate well and are comfortable translating technical and business needs into working solutions together with a product team
* Are self-driven, take ownership of your work, and know when to ask for input
* Are curious about AI-assisted and agentic development, and enjoy using AI tools actively and thoughtfully in your everyday work



  





**About Framna** 




**Framna means ‘to bring forward’ in Old Norse. And that is exactly what we do. We partner with industry leaders (and those about to be) to create excellent digital products that define markets, reshape industries, and deliver meaningful impact.** 




  





**Born from the union of digital agencies Bontouch, Move, and Shape, Framna emerged from a strong, product-led culture. Today, over 600 of us collaborate across 11 studios in Denmark, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, and the US.** 




  





**Every day, millions of users around the world rely on the products we help shape. From seamless payments to daily commutes, from better health management to smarter shopping. Our work supports more than €150 million in daily transactions and consistently earns an average App Store rating of 4.5.** 




  





**Together with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, including Essity, SJ, Swish, SEB, and Vattenfall, we craft products that lead markets and push boundaries. Because when products win, businesses win. We call it Win by product.** 




  





**What you get** 



* **A role with real impact.** 
 You will play a key role in shaping Framna’s growth by developing our most important partnerships and expanding how we work together.
* **A culture of curiosity.** 
 A culture of curiosity. We have weekly Friday demos, and different communities across the company where people meet up, share knowledge, and dig into topics they're interested in together. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we make room for learning when there's something new we want to explore.
* **The freedom to follow your “what if.”** 
 We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you are curious about something, you will have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.
* **Teammates who bring their whole selves.** 
 Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.
* **And of course, the benefits you’d expect.** 
 A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.



  





**Our hiring process** 



* Recruiter screening call
* Interview with hiring manager
* Case assignment
* Technical interview
* Reference check



  





**Please note:** 
 we're office first, with our
 **Stockholm studio** 
 as our main hub for demos, fika, and everyday collaboration, mixed with the freedom to work from home when it makes sense. You need to be based in Stockholm or within commuting distance. Unfortunately we're not able to offer relocation.
 



  





 We're reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don't wait to apply. We look forward to learning more about you!

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
**Who are Benifex?** 
 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and
 **one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world.** 
 We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build
 **workplace technology** 
 that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to
 **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** 
 Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best,
 **we need brilliant people** 
 on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why should you apply? 🌟**
* Impact: work on a product suite used by millions of people that improves employee experience and wellbeing.
* Scale: a big focus of our engineering teams is building features and services to support our customers globally.
* Autonomy: have an input into the product roadmap and technically lead features/services.
* Development: this is a crucial part of our aim to ensure a seamless experience across FPS.
* Top 10 Employer, Sunday Times Best Places to Work Awards
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and benefits space


**Role Overview 🚀**
 As a Senior Fullstack Engineer, you will work across frontend and backend areas that support Benifex employee experience products, mobile app, and platform look and feel.
   

  

 The team is responsible for operational continuity, technical stability, and continuous improvement beyond the product roadmap, which means the work often involves balancing new development with careful maintenance, refactoring, and production reliability.
   

  

 This role suits someone who enjoys complex domains, established systems, and end-to-end ownership. You will contribute to frontend development in React, TypeScript, and Angular, while also designing and maintaining backend services, APIs, and integrations using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
   

  

 We are also on a journey to use AI more deliberately in our daily engineering work. We are looking for someone who has practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows, or who wants to keep exploring how these tools can help us move faster, improve quality, understand complex codebases, and reduce repetitive work without lowering our engineering standards.
   

  

**Great Benefits**
 🧠 ITP1 pension.
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings.
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement.
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal.
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance.
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year.
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses.
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay.
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

**Responsibilities 🤘**
* Design, build, and maintain fullstack features across employee experience products and platform UI areas.
* Build frontend functionality in React and TypeScript and support existing Angular-based applications.
* Develop and maintain backend services, APIs, and data flows using Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL.
* Integrate frontend experiences with reliable, well-designed APIs and platform services.
* Safely evolve a large, long-lived codebase through incremental refactoring and technical debt reduction.
* Treat reliability, security, performance, accessibility, and maintainability as core parts of delivery.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation, and knowledge-sharing.
* Help investigate bugs and production issues, identify root causes, and prevent recurring problems.
* Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical decisions within the team.
* Use AI-assisted and agentic coding tools thoughtfully as part of daily development, code exploration, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
* Help the team learn where AI adds value, where human judgement is still essential, and how to use these tools responsibly in a complex production codebase.


**What are we looking for? 🔎**
* Java, Spring/Spring Boot, and SQL: Needed to build and maintain backend services, APIs, and data-driven functionality.
* React, TypeScript, and Angular: Needed to contribute across both future frontend development and existing FPS frontend areas.
* API design and integration: Important for creating dependable interfaces between frontend, backend, and platform services.
* Testing, CI/CD, and observability: Needed to deliver reliable changes and diagnose issues in production-like environments.
* AI-assisted and agentic coding: Practical experience using AI coding tools to explore codebases, generate or refactor code, write tests, support reviews, or accelerate delivery while maintaining strong engineering judgement.


**Please note:** 
 Our recruitment process will begin in mid-to-late August, once the hiring team has returned from their summer holidays. We appreciate your patience and look forward to reviewing your application.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving and reading your application!
   

  

**Our Interview Process ✌**
 Benifex understand the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible, typically a 2-2.5 week timeframe.
   

  

 📞 Initial informal call with the Talent team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview with our Engineering Director 30-45 min
   

  

 🧪 Technical Task
   

  

 🔎 Technical Interview - 60 min
   

  

 🤩 Final interview with VP of Engineering - 30-45 min
   

  

  

  

**We are a proud member of the Disability Confident employer scheme.**
**If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage during the recruitment process, please let us know with your application.**

title: Integrationsutvecklare till Unionens IT-enhet
description:
Vill du bygga robusta och säkra integrationslösningar som får verksamhetskritiska system, data och processer att fungera tillsammans? Hos Unionen får du en central roll i utvecklingen av vårt integrationslandskap, med möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, integrationsarkitektur och arbetssätt i vår fortsatta digitalisering.
   

  

 Som integrationsutvecklare ansvarar du för att designa, utveckla, testa och underhålla integrationer mellan Unionens interna och externa system. Du omsätter verksamhetsbehov till hållbara integrationsflöden och arbetar med API-baserade, händelsedrivna och meddelandebaserade lösningar. Rollen omfattar hela livscykeln – från kravanalys och lösningsdesign till driftsättning, övervakning, felsökning och kontinuerlig förbättring.
   

  

 Rollen är hands-on och har samtidigt ett tydligt ansvar för kvaliteten i integrationsområdet. Du samarbetar nära arkitekter, utvecklingsteam, produktägare, verksamhet och leverantörer för att skapa väl dokumenterade, återanvändbara och framtidssäkra lösningar. Genom gemensamma integrationsmönster, automatiserade leveranser och god spårbarhet bidrar du till stabila informationsflöden och effektiva digitala tjänster för Unionens medlemmar och medarbetare.
   

  

 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet som utvecklar och förvaltar Unionens integrationslösningar. Arbetet präglas av helhetsperspektiv, informationssäkerhet och en ambition att standardisera integrationsmönster, minska punkt-till-punkt-kopplingar och skapa lösningar som är enkla att övervaka, felsöka och vidareutveckla.
   

  

 Du arbetar i ett agilt utvecklingsteam med utvecklare, arkitekter samt test- och utvecklingsledare. Teamet består av både Unionens anställda och konsulter och arbetar nära verksamheten.
   

  

* Analysera integrationsbehov och omsätta verksamhetskrav till teknisk design, gränssnittskontrakt och dataflöden.
* Designa, utveckla och förvalta API-baserade, händelsedrivna, meddelandebaserade och schemalagda integrationer mellan interna och externa system.
* Utveckla integrationslösningar i Azure och Microsofts ekosystem, exempelvis med API Management, Service Bus, Functions, Logic Apps och .NET.
* Integrera verksamhetssystem, datakällor, molntjänster och externa tjänster med hjälp av lämpliga API:er och integrationsmönster.
* Säkerställa autentisering, behörighetsstyrning, dataskydd, felhantering, loggning och spårbarhet i integrationsflödena.
* Automatisera bygg, test och driftsättning samt bidra till versionshantering och CI/CD för integrationslösningar.
* Övervaka och felsöka integrationer, analysera rotorsaker och genomföra förbättringar som stärker tillgänglighet och prestanda.
* Dokumentera lösningar, utveckla gemensamma integrationsmönster och dela kunskap med team, arkitekter och leverantörer.


 Vem är du?
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är en erfaren integrationsutvecklare och som trivs med att ta ansvar för hela integrationskedjan. Du kombinerar god programmeringsförmåga med förståelse för integrationsarkitektur, informationsflöden och drift. Du kan växla mellan nyutveckling, förvaltning och felsökning och bidrar gärna till gemensamma standarder och tekniska vägval.
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har
   

  

* Flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling i komplexa systemlandskap.
* Goda kunskaper i C# och .NET samt erfarenhet av REST-baserade API:er, JSON och autentiseringslösningar.
* Erfarenhet av integrationsmönster såsom synkrona och asynkrona flöden, meddelandeköer, händelser, batch och datatransformation.
* Erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services, exempelvis API Management, Service Bus, Functions eller Logic Apps.
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, automatiserade tester, loggning, övervakning och felsökning av integrationslösningar.
* Förståelse för API-säkerhet, identitet, behörighet och hantering av känslig information.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt.


 Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och prestigelös. Du trivs i en miljö med hög förändringstakt och många kontaktytor, samarbetar väl i team och kan samtidigt arbeta självständigt för att nå områdets mål. Du tänker långsiktigt, strävar efter ständig förbättring och är trygg med att förutsättningar kan förändras.
   

  

 Omfattning
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med månadslön och goda villkor enligt kollektivavtal. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse och provanställning kan tillämpas. Kontoret på Olof Palmes gata är vår primära arbetsplats, med möjlighet att utföra visst arbete hemifrån eller från annan plats.
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 23 oktober. Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningstiden, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningstid löpt ut.
   

  

 I din ansökan vill vi att du inkluderar ett motivationsbrev där du berättar vad som lockar dig med rollen på Unionen.
   

  

 Unionen välkomnar olikheter i personalgrupperna och eftersträvar mångfald i alla avseenden.
   

  

 Kontakt
   

  

**Jörgen Westerberg, sektionschef**
 jorgen.westerberg@unionen.se
   

  

 08-504 15 585
   

  

**Elahe Sharifi, fackligt ombud**
 elahe.sharifi@unionen.se
   

  

 08-504 15 430
   

  

 Om Unionen
   

  

**Vill du få kraft att göra skillnad?**
 Unionen är Sveriges största fackförbund på den privata arbetsmarknaden och landets största tjänstemannaförbund. Vår vision är att skapa trygghet, framgång och glädje i arbetslivet. Vi har inflytande, ansvar och ambition för mer än bara oss själva och mod att driva frågor som påverkar hela samhället. Varje dag hjälper vi människor i det privata arbetslivet att få det bättre på arbetsplatsen. Därför har vi en erfarenhet och bredd som ingen annan – och vi behöver dig som vill göra oss ännu bättre.
   

  

 Unionen finns i allt från stora internationella koncerner till små familjeföretag, organisationer och föreningar. Vi är en medlemsstyrd organisation byggd på representativ demokrati, med omkring 700 000 medlemmar och cirka 29 000 förtroendevalda på 16 000 arbetsplatser. Läs mer på www.unionen.se.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create ideas, experiences, and stories that move people and brands forward. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we craft culturally resonant work that blends creativity, storytelling, design, technology, and innovation to create meaningful impact.
   

  

 In the heart of innovation, AKQA Sweden thrives. We are privileged to collaborate with a fantastic portfolio of clients, including Volvo Cars, Google, Volvo Penta, H&M, IKEA, and more. Each partnership is a shared pursuit of creating transformative digital products and services tailored to their distinct needs and aspirations. We are in relentless pursuit of the beyond, shaping the future with our clients, our people, and our planet at the core. Our work is not just our profession, it's our passion, and our commitment is to a future where everyone has the opportunity to shine. We are not just creating for today: we are creating the Future. Faster.
   

  

 Working in the Tech team connects you with talented experts across disciplines who are passionate about delivering work of the highest quality and creating maximum value for our clients.
   

  

 You should be an established fullstack engineer, fluent in modern headless web development end-to-end. You build best-in-class applications across the frontend, API layer, and data sources using a serverless-first, composable architecture.
   

  

 AKQA is a proud member of the MACH Alliance, and we build completely headless, modern web solutions without the overhead of legacy monoliths or self-hosted infrastructure.
   

  

**Role Requirements**
* Hands-on Delivery: Lead hands-on development on medium-to-large scale client projects.
* Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with UX, Design, Strategy, and Delivery to solve implementation challenges and turn creative visions into performant code.
* Team Mentorship: Support team members' growth by sharing knowledge, conducting code reviews, and fostering an open learning culture.
* Client Alignment: Understand client business goals to architect and implement the right technical solutions.
* Engineering Quality: Own code quality end-to-end, ensuring solutions are accessible (a11y), performant, secure, and thoroughly tested.
* Modern Ways of Working: Active practitioner of Lean & Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) with a focus on continuous delivery and improvement.
* Frontend & Frameworks: Advanced TypeScript / JavaScript (ESLatest), HTML5, Accessibility (a11y), and production-scale mastery of Next.js and React.
* Headless & Composable Web: Experience building with headless CMS platforms like Contentful, Strapi, or Sanity, and search/indexing tools like Algolia.
* Backend & Data: Building light serverless API routes in Next.js, experience with Hasura for GraphQL backends, and hosted databases like Neon Postgres or cloud (No)SQL.
* Platform & Hosting: Deployment on Vercel; familiarity integrating with client enterprise cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) when client requirements dictate.
* AI-Assisted Workflow: Comfortable using AI developer tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and leveraging the Vercel AI SDK for building AI-driven features into web apps.
* Testing & Performance: CI/CD pipelines, automated testing (Vitest, Playwright, Cypress), performance profiling, and multi-locale internationalisation (i18n).
* Mobile app development using React Native with Expo (Expo-managed workflow) is beneficial.
* E-commerce integrations and payment gateway experience is beneficial.
* Experience with web animation tools such as Framer Motion, GSAP, and CSS animations is beneficial.


 We look for self-starting technologists who adapt quickly across a modern web landscape. The technologies above outline our most commonly used technologies at AKQA Sweden; if you have experience with comparable alternatives, that is not a blocker to success.
   

  

 QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS
   

  

* 5+ years of industry experience in fullstack web development.
* Analytical, positive mindset with a personable and professional communication style.
* Comfortable translating complex technical topics for non-technical team members and clients.
* Passion for high-detail execution, performance optimization, and new technology.
* A collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively across UX, Design, Strategy, Delivery, and Technology.
* A commitment to sharing knowledge, supporting team members' growth, and fostering an open learning culture.
* A strong understanding of client business goals and the ability to align technical solutions to those needs.
* A focus on accessible, performant, secure, well-tested, high-quality engineering.
* Comfortable working in a Lean and Agile environment, including Scrum and Kanban, with a focus on continuous delivery and improvement.


 Explore our extensive range of benefits here
   

  

 We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Junior Baseband Software Developer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Want to take a challenge to shape a new world of communications?
   

  

 Join Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Software organization and help build the technology that powers next-generation mobile networks.
   

  

 We are looking for SW Engineers who want to work with us to increase our customers’ satisfaction with 5G Baseband SW as well as to develop a new 6G RAN technology. Here you get opportunity to work alongside experience developers to learn how Ericsson system is designed, implemented, tested and integrated.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for those of you who are eager to learn, adaptable, like solving technical problems and really enjoy collaborating.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Develop and maintain Ericsson's Purpose Build RAN Layer 1 Baseband software
* Develop a new generation of RAN SW (6G)
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to support your activities like developing code, test creation, debugging, documentation, and code review
* Learn how 5G/6G radio systems and physical layer processing work
* Participate in feature development, debugging, testing, code reviews, and continuous integration activities
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, system engineers, and testers across global teams
* Work with software quality, test coverage, maintainability, and continuous improvement
* Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product
* Grow your technical skills through mentorship, feedback, and hands-on experience


**The skills you bring:**
* A recently completed, or soon to be completed, BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Embedded Systems, Telecommunications, or a related discipline
* Programming experience in C/C++, Python
* Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts
* Practical experience using Python for data processing, experimentation, or machine learning through university coursework, thesis work, or personal projects
* Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Interest in software engineering, high-performance systems, and telecommunications
* Good communication skills in English


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. title: Senior Principal Runtime Engineer
description:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Runtime team at Sambanova is a seasoned engineering team with a proven track record of delivering cutting-edge system software solutions for AI and machine learning applications in the enterprise & commercial landscape.
   

  

 Runtime is responsible for the lowest levels of the SambaNova stack, efficiently interacting with the hardware to provide the best application performance and maximize hardware utilization. We handle all aspects of software infrastructure to enable higher level applications, including:
   

  

* High performance user libraries
* Operating System interface/integration
* Data model manipulation for scaling
* Networking/communication intra and inter node
* Orchestration of partitioned workloads
* Error monitoring and tools for system management and observability


 We build a high performance, distributed and scalable software execution environment for SambaNova DataScale & Cloud platforms to support data-flow applications such as ML training and inference and HPC applications.
   

  

 We are searching for a software engineer who will work on all parts of the runtime stacks, supporting AI, ML, and scientific applications in high-performance distributed systems. You will participate in building, testing and deploying next-generation high-performance compute systems for AI applications at scale. We expect the candidate to have a strong background in programming, building and testing software in distributed systems, performance tuning of large scale systems, and good teamwork and planning skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Work on design and implementation of new and enhanced features of the runtime stack to support high performance and scalable ML inference and training applications
* System software (drivers and kernel) support for the next generation silicon.
* Design user-space libraries for high performance and high utilization of HW resources.
* User-facing tools (analysis, job and HW management, profiling, debugging, etc) for Datascale systems.
* Collaborate with other teams including Hardware, ML Application, Compiler, DevOps.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent and with 3-5 years of industry experience
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python
* Experience with user space libraries, operating systems, and kernel drivers
* Experience working with highly concurrent and distributed systems, with a focus on performance and scalability


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with different types of fabrics, such as PCIe, Infiniband, and RoCE
* Experience with fast networking stacks, such as RDMA
* Good communication skills and enthusiasm to help colleagues


**Submission Guidelines**
 Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified.
   

  

**EEO Policy**
 SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

**Benefits Summary For US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions**
 SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.

 AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s embedded in how we work helping engineers move faster, reduce friction and focus on solving meaningful problems.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer - Build the Data Foundation for a Fast-Moving Nordic E-commerce Business
 



  





 What if your next Data Engineering role gave you the chance to do much more than build pipelines?
 



  





 We’re working with a fast-moving Nordic e-commerce business that is transforming the way it works with data, AI and technology. Data sits at the heart of the organisation - powering everything from business intelligence and operational decision-making to automation and emerging AI use cases.
 



  





 The company is currently going through a major transformation of its data environment, and this is a particularly exciting time to join. The foundations are being rebuilt, new ways of working are being introduced, and there is a huge opportunity to shape how data is used across the business.
 



  





 They’re looking for a Data Engineer who is genuinely curious about technology, understands the bigger picture, and enjoys figuring out how to solve problems rather than simply completing tickets.
 



  






 The Role:
 




 You’ll join a small, highly collaborative data team and work across the full data landscape.
 



 The core of the role is data modelling and building a strong, scalable data foundation, but you’ll also have the freedom to step outside the traditional boundaries of Data Engineering.
 



  





 One day you could be building a robust data model in dbt and BigQuery. The next, you might be building a Python service, creating an API to expose data, automating a business process, or helping develop an interface that allows AI agents to interact with company data.
 



  





 They’re looking for someone who can look at a problem and think:
 



  





 'What do we actually need to build to solve this?'
 



  





 Rather than someone who only wants to work within one predefined part of the stack.
 



  






 What you’ll be working on:
 



* Build and maintain high-quality data models using SQL and dbt
* Help develop and evolve the company's modern data warehouse
* Work with data coming from a range of different sources and systems
* Build Python-based services, applications and integrations where needed
* Develop APIs and other interfaces for making data accessible to applications and AI agents
* Work with data ingestion and automation using tools such as Airbyte
* Contribute to infrastructure and deployments using GCP, Docker and Terraform
* Troubleshoot existing data flows and improve reliability and scalability
* Help create the technical foundations for new AI and automation use cases
* Work closely with stakeholders to understand the business problem behind a request and turn it into a sustainable technical solution
* Contribute to improving engineering practices, architecture and ways of working across the data team



  






 The Technology:
 




 The core data stack is built around:
 



  





 dbt · Google BigQuery · SQL · Python · GCP · Docker · Terraform · Airbyte
 



  





 Experience with every technology isn't expected. In fact, they’re deliberately open to people who have worked with different cloud environments or tools.
 



  





 What matters more is that you understand the underlying concepts and are someone who can pick up new technology quickly.
 



  






 Who are they looking for?
 




 This role would suit a full-stack data-minded engineer - someone who is technically strong in data but also enjoys getting involved in the wider engineering challenge.
 



  





 You might be a Data Engineer who has:
 


* Strong SQL and data modelling experience
* Solid experience with dbt
* Used Python to build pipelines, services or applications
* Worked with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS
* Built APIs or other services around data
* Worked with infrastructure, deployment or automation
* Experience in a start-up, scale-up, innovation environment or consultancy
* Had to figure things out independently rather than working within a highly structured enterprise environment



  





 You don't need to have done everything listed above.
 



  





 They are much more interested in what you have actually built, how you approach problems, and how quickly you can understand something new.
 



  





 This isn't a role for someone who wants to spend all day exclusively focused on ingestion pipelines.
 



 Likewise, they're not looking for a Software Engineer who simply has an interest in data.
 



  





 The sweet spot is someone with data at their core, who can also move comfortably into engineering when the problem requires it.
 



  





 You might have built an API to serve data to another application.
 



 You might have created an internal tool with a light front end.
 



 You might have automated something that previously required manual work.
 



 You might have worked on an AI or ML-related use case.
 



  





 Or you might simply have spent time in a smaller environment where you had to work things out and build whatever was needed.
 



  





 The common thread is curiosity, ownership and a willingness to solve the whole problem.
 



  





 There is already a modern technology foundation in place, but there is a lot left to build. That means you'll have genuine influence over architecture, technical decisions and how the team evolves.
 



  






 The environment:
 




 This is a relatively small and highly collaborative technology organisation where things move quickly.
 



  





 You'll work closely with people across the business, and the demand for data is high. Stakeholders have ambitious ideas and plenty of use cases they want to explore, so you'll need to be comfortable prioritising, communicating clearly and working as part of a team.
 



  





 The ideal person will enjoy an environment where:
 


* Things aren't always perfectly defined
* You have genuine ownership over your work
* You can challenge how things are currently done
* You need to figure things out rather than follow a rigid process
* You work closely with the business rather than operating in a technical silo
* There is plenty of opportunity to experiment with new technology
* People are ambitious, social and genuinely enjoy working together



  





 The culture is fast-moving, informal and collaborative, with relatively little bureaucracy. You’ll know the people around you, understand what the wider business is trying to achieve and have the opportunity to see your work make a tangible difference.
 



  






 The practical details:
 



* Location: Stockholm
* Working model: Hybrid - typically 3 days per week in the office
* Language: English is fully workable; Swedish is a plus
* Salary: Around 50.000-65.000 SEK/month, dependent on experience & with flexibility for an exceptional profile
* Team: Small, growing Data team with close collaboration across the wider technology organisation



  





 Interested?
 



 If you're a Data Engineer who wants to work somewhere you can build, experiment, solve real business problems and have a genuine say in how data and technology evolve, this could be a very interesting opportunity.
 



  





 The team is particularly interested in hearing about what you've actually built, the environments you've thrived in, and the times you've had to figure out a difficult technical problem without everything being handed to you.
 



  





 If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
