title: Partner Solution Architect, Regional System Integrators
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in public cloud architecture, including compute, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and microservices.
* Experience in pre-sales acceleration, technical proofs-of-concept (PoCs), and leading technical workshops.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Deep Domain Specialization (AI, Data, or Infrastructure), expert-level depth in at least ONE domain.
* Experience in enterprise technology buying and evaluation processes paired with an understanding of computing solutions, and the business-to-technology translation skills to challenge partner delivery strategies.
* Ability to deliver results and work cross-functionally alongside direct Google Cloud Platform Customer Engineers to position and orchestrate a solution consisting of multiple products.
* Ability to drive and influence Partner Tech audiences, identify expansion engagements within partner accounts, and ensure accelerated velocity with zero partner-delivery escalations on Partner-led delivery deals .


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
   

  

 As a Partner Solution Architect, you will serve as the pre-sales solution design authority for our priority Regional System Integrators and strategic partners across EMEA.
   

  

 As a part of this role, you will operate strictly ring-fenced from Global System Integrator engagements, you are the ecosystem co-pilot to Google Cloud's Account Platform Customer Engineers, where the Account Platform CE owns the direct customer relationship and strategy, you own your partner's technical capability to successfully deliver it. You will move seamlessly from regional advisory to deep, domain-specific execution (AI, Data, or Infrastructure) to capture the pre-sales gap, while ruthlessly deflecting post-sales delivery.
   

  

 You will work in close collaboration with the Partner Development Managers responsible for the RSIs and Strategic Partners in your sub-region to create, drive and execute a joint business plan successfully, focusing on most impactful engagements across your sub-region and contribute to Partner Community in your domain of expertise.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 Sweden: kr1040000 - kr1060000 (SEK) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Drive VIP, "Red-Carpet" bootcamps and hackathons for partners to accelerate sales cycles and to ensure high-quality on time delivery, driving a successful path to consumption.
* Provide targeted pre-sales architectural support exclusively for RSIs and strategic partners in South, acting as a technical peer to Account CEs to unblock complex deals or customize partner activation, while leading the tech review and validation of highest impact Statements of Work (SoWs) to ensure a strict path to production and secure Partner funding Return on Investment (ROI).
* Serve as the regional pre-sales design authority by authoring baseline enterprise replicable assets ( functional AI demos for example) and leading deep-dive technical sessions and hackathons for the regional Partner Tech Community to broadcast enablement 1-to-many.
* Contribute actively to building, running and maintaining EMEA Partner Tech Community.

title: Operations Developer
description:
E.ON i Sverige är en del av den internationella energikoncernen E.ON SE med huvudkontor i Essen, Tyskland. Inom koncernen arbetar runt 70 000 personer i 17 länder. Runt om i Sverige arbetar runt 2100 engagerade medarbetare. Vårt nordiska huvudkontor finns i Malmö. I Sverige levererar vi el, värme och smarta energilösningar till drygt en miljon hushåll och företag. E.ON:s roll är att ta ansvar för och driva utvecklingen framåt, för att fler ska kunna ställa om. Med våra investeringar och våra kunders vilja att bidra arbetar vi för att fortsätta elektrifiera samhället och möta framtidens energibehov.
   

  

**Om oss**
 Gruppen Anläggningsstrategi är en del av avdelningen Anläggningsstyrning inom Lokalnätet. Enkelt sagt står Anläggningsstyrning för vårt "hur” och ”vad" och våra kollegor runtom i landet för "att" det blir gjort. Tillsammans med enheterna och samarbetspartners ska vi bygga, utveckla och underhålla lokalnätet för våra ca 1 miljon kunder och det är en självklarhet att detta ska göras på det säkraste och mest hållbara sättet möjligt.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Vi söker nu två personer som kommer jobba med vår investering- och förvaltningsstrategi och säkerställa att dessa bryts ner i aktiviteter som bidrar till våra långsiktiga mål - tekniskt, ekonomiskt och hållbart.
   

  

 Du följer kontinuerligt upp, analyserar och identifierar behov av justeringar i våra investeringar, med fokus på att de ligger i linje med tekniska riktlinjer, risknivåer och övergripande strategi. Rollen är datadriven och analytisk, med stor möjlighet att påverka vad vi investerar i – och när.
   

  

 I rollen ingår även att:
   

  

* Tillsammans med våra experter och specialister genomföra utvärdering av befintliga och nya komponenter för att hitta förbättringar ur ett kostnads- eller hållbarhetsperspektiv.
* Samverka så att våra processer och investerings- och förvaltningsstrategi går i linje med varandra.
* Samverka så att våra entreprenörer kan utföra arbete i linje med vår strategi både när det gäller att bygga likväl som underhåll.
* Samverka brett inom organisationen kring tekniska vägval, prioriteringar och långsiktiga åtgärdsplaner


 Tjänsten innebär resande i begränsad omfattning.
   

  

**Dina erfarenheter**
 Vi söker dig som är genuint intresserad av teknik och har en erfarenhet inom elnätsbranschen eller annan infrastrukturnära bransch. Vi ser gärna att du har en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning, men är inte ett krav om du har erfarenhet inom branschen. Du har arbetat i roller som innebär exempelvis analys, projekt eller förvaltning, arbetsuppgifter du utför med nyfikenhet, struktur och genom samarbete. Arbetet kommer innebära samverkan i nationella och globala samarbeten i olika grupper över hela E.ON.
   

  

 Eftersom rollen innebär mycket samverkan med såväl kollegor, entreprenörer som samarbetspartners, söker vi dig som har ett smidigt kommunikationssätt och kan skapa intresse hos dina mottagare. Vi behöver arbeta som ett för att verkligen lyckas med den här omställningen – vi blir bättre tillsammans!
   

  

**Hur är det hos oss?**
 Magnus Bengtsson kommer att bli din närmaste chef. Han har ett ledarskap där dina och teamets idéer styr arbetsgången samt där kulturen präglas av förtroende och tillit. Teamets välmående och utveckling är en förutsättning för att vi ska lyckas i vårt arbete. Med ett coachande förhållningssätt och stor tilltro till teamets förmåga leder han genom tydlig målstyrning, klara ansvarsområden och regelbunden uppföljning, där dialog och coaching är självklar del av vardagen.
   

  

 På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.
   

  

 Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin egen hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är t.ex. arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!
   

  

 Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 4 oktober
   

  

**För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef:**
 Magnus Bengtsson, magnus.bengtsson@eon.se
   

  

**För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:**
 Unionen, Unionen.EED@eon.se
   

  

 Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.se
   

  

 Mattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.se

title: CTO / Lead Developer - Platform Team
description:
Hacksaw Studios is looking for a highly experienced CTO / Lead Developer to join and lead our platform team.
   

  

 The platform team is responsible for building, maintaining, and continuously improving the core remote gaming server platform used across the group. This is a high-volume, transactional system operating in the online gaming industry, where scalability, security, reliability, and code quality are critical.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. You will take ownership of the ongoing development and maintenance of the remote gaming server platform, as well as other platform-related services including API gateway solutions, back-office systems, integrations, and future unannounced projects.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As CTO / Lead Developer for the platform team, you will be expected to combine strong technical leadership with hands-on development. You will work closely with the engineering team, senior management, and other departments to ensure that our platform continues to scale, perform, and meet the high standards required in a regulated industry.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving technical decisions, improving architecture, reviewing and writing code, mentoring developers, and ensuring that the platform remains stable, secure, and maintainable as the business grows.
   

  

 A key part of the role will also be communication. You will need to clearly explain technical decisions, platform changes, risks, priorities, and ongoing work to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This includes regular reporting to senior management, as well as close collaboration with departments such as Frontend, DevOps, Sysadmin, and Support to ensure they understand the platform, upcoming changes, operational impact, and how best to support the systems in production.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the technical direction and development of the remote gaming server platform
* Take ownership of platform architecture, scalability, performance, and security
* Write, review, and deliver high-quality C# code
* Maintain and improve core transactional systems handling high volumes of traffic
* Work with SQL databases and ensure strong data integrity, performance, and reliability
* Support and improve related platform services, including API gateways and back-office systems
* Report progress, priorities, risks, and technical decisions to senior management
* Communicate clearly with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and other departments about platform functionality, changes, incidents, and operational requirements
* Help educate relevant teams on how the platform works and how changes may affect their areas
* Promote strong engineering practices, including unit testing, code reviews, and maintainable architecture
* Help the team operate effectively in a highly regulated industry
* Mentor and support developers while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day implementation
* Contribute to future platform initiatives and new technical projects


**Requirements**
* Extensive professional experience with C# and .NET
* Strong experience building scalable, production-grade backend systems
* Very strong SQL skills, including performance optimization and data modelling
* Understanding of caching principles in Redis or similar
* Experience working with transaction-based systems, ideally in online gaming, fintech, payments, trading, or similar industries
* Experience designing and operating horizontally scaled systems
* Strong understanding of system architecture, API design, reliability, and security
* Experience working with high-volume systems where uptime and correctness are critical
* A strong focus on code quality, testing, and maintainability
* Comfortable being hands-on and spending a significant amount of time coding
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience working across departments such as DevOps, infrastructure, support, product, or operations
* Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions in a fast-moving environment


 Nice to have
   

  

* Experience from the online gaming or gambling industry
* Experience working in regulated environments
* Experience with remote gaming server platforms, payment systems, or other mission-critical transactional platforms
* Experience designing analytics systems for handling very large data sets for reporting purposes
* Experience leading engineering teams or acting as a technical owner for a major platform
* Experience with back-office systems, API gateways and integrations into third-party systems
* Experience reporting to or working directly with senior management


 What we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who enjoys taking real technical ownership who is a strong, hands-on developer. You should be excited by complex backend systems, care deeply about quality, and be comfortable balancing long-term architecture with hands-on delivery.
   

  

 You should be able to lead from the front, contribute directly to the codebase, and help the team make good technical decisions while keeping the platform secure, scalable, and reliable.
   

  

 Just as importantly, you should be a strong communicator. The platform team works closely with DevOps, sysadmin, support, and senior management, and this role will be expected to create clarity across those teams. You should be comfortable explaining what the platform team is doing, why certain technical decisions are being made, what risks or priorities exist, and how other departments are affected.
   

  

**About Hacksaw**
 Hacksaw is a fast-growing company in the online gaming industry, building products and platforms used by operators and players across multiple markets. We work in a highly regulated environment and place strong emphasis on quality, reliability, and responsible technical delivery.
   

  

 If you are an experienced C# developer and technical leader who wants to take ownership of a critical high-volume gaming platform, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

 Practical Details
   

  

* This is an on-site position in Stockholm.


 Ready to Join the Game Makers?
   

  

 Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:

 As one of the world’s leading audiobook and e-book streaming platforms, Storytel brings unlimited listening to millions of users across 25 markets. We’re at the forefront of digital storytelling, driven by a vision to make the world a more empathetic and creative place.
   

  

 Ready for your next chapter? We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join the team in Stockholm.

 Join a world of stories

 Does this sound like you? If you feel like Storytel is a place where you could thrive, please submit your application in English and we will contact you as soon as possible.

title: Master Thesis: AI-Powered Autonomous Test Environment Orchestration
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 We are looking for a motivated Master's student to investigate how AI agents and data-quality-aware orchestration can reduce the effort and increase the reliability of integration test environment preparation.
   

  

 Modern orchestration systems depend on configuration data, infrastructure metadata, and environment definitions originating from multiple sources. Inconsistent or low-quality data can lead to orchestration failures, environment-provisioning issues, and increased operational overhead.
   

  

 This thesis will explore how AI, orchestration, and data management can be combined to create more reliable and autonomous test-environment workflows. The work complements related efforts in AI-driven test automation and supports the LaaS and OAS ambitions.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Investigate how data quality affects integration test environment preparation and orchestration reliability.

title: Master Thesis: Diagnostic Framework for DMA Engine IP Pipeline Stalls and Performance Regression
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 High-performance DMA engines move large data between on-chip memory, external memories, and interconnected resources, offloading transfers from DSPs and CPUs. Because data and control paths are deep and tightly coupled, performance loss is hard to localize. Pipeline stalls (bubbles) can stem from arbitration delays, backpressure, or credit exhaustion; the observed throughput drop alone doesn’t reveal why. Typical UVM-based performance environments quantify behavior — sweeping DMA size, queue loading, traffic patterns, and interface latency — to flag below-expectation operating points, but they don’t explain root cause. Today, closing this gap means digging into waveforms and manually correlating throughput loss to specific stall events, conditions, and stages — a time-consuming process that’s often inconclusive given pipeline depth and concurrency.
   

  

 In this thesis, you will build a diagnostic observability layer that plugs into the existing UVM performance environment and turns each sub-par point on a performance curve into a localized, actionable root-cause explanation. The layer should automatically capture where stalls occur, under which conditions, and from which internal or external source — making performance debugging early, repeatable, and conclusive instead of a manual end-stage effort. A secondary track can extend this to dataset design for AI-parseable stall analysis.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 The assignment of this thesis is twofold. The first goal is to establish a custom dynamic stall identification (runtime/observability) framework:
   

  

* Instrument the DMA Engine pipeline within the existing UVM performance environment with non-intrusive monitors capturing per-stage handshake activity, occupancy, and stall conditions.
* Define a precise, measurable notion of a stall relative to the saturated reference case.
* Produce a time-stamped, structured dataset (CSV/Parquet) of stall events tagged with stage, condition, and surrounding context.
* Classify stall sources by origin: internal (arbitration, descriptor fetch latency, FIFO backpressure, etc.) vs. external (interconnect/AXI backpressure, roundtrip latency, etc.).
* HTML dashboard, built from the Parquet dataset, presenting per-sweep metrics, stall summaries, and automatically flagged issues.
* Preliminary root-cause ranking of the top stall contributors across the sweep space.


 The second goal is about producing a validated datapath and control-path dependency map (static cartography):
   

  

* Build a documented and validated map of the DMA data path and control path: pipeline stages, buffers, arbitration points, and the control dependencies that gate forward progress.
* Represent dependencies as a graph linking each observed dynamic stall class to its structural origin.
* Use the cartography to explain why a given condition produces a stall, not just that it does.


**The skills you bring:**
* Master’s studies in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or similar.
* Background in computer architecture, ASIC design, RTL HDL coding, and testbench design using SystemVerilog.
* Working knowledge of UVM and scripting (Tcl/Python) for EDA tools is preferred.
* Curiosity to turn throughput “symptoms” into clear, data-backed root causes — and the discipline to design controlled measurements.

Förutom att driva den dagliga provningen kommer du successivt att utveckla kompetens inom testutveckling, utveckling av testskript och automatisering. Du blir en viktig del i arbetet med att förbättra och standardisera våra metoder.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som vill växa med verksamheten. På sikt ser vi att du tar ett större tekniskt ansvar för våra batteriprovningar, från testupplägg och automatisering till utveckling av nya provningsmetoder och kundprojekt. Ambitionen är att du över tid utvecklas till en nyckelperson inom batteriprovning med ansvar för såväl teknik som provningsstrategier och metodutveckling.
   

  

 Ansvarsområden
   

  

* Planera, genomföra och följa upp batteriprovning.
* Ansvara för säker och effektiv drift av provceller och testutrustning.
* Installera, konfigurera och övervaka provobjekt och mätsystem.
* Utveckla och underhålla testskript för automatiserad provning.
* Felsöka och analysera testresultat samt identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter.
* Bidra till utveckling av testmetoder, processer och arbetssätt.
* Samverka med kunder, leverantörer och interna projektteam.
* Säkerställa att arbetet genomförs enligt gällande säkerhets- och kvalitetskrav.


**Vem du är**
 Du är en person med ett stort tekniskt intresse som drivs av att förstå hur teknik fungerar i praktiken. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och trivs med att sätta dig in i nya områden. Du motiveras av att lära nytt och vill bygga vidare på dina kunskaper inom batteriprovning, testutveckling och automatisering.
   

  

 Du arbetar strukturerat och noggrant, tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra. Samtidigt har du initiativförmåga och motiveras av att bidra till utveckling och förbättringar av både teknik och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Krav
   

  

* Ingenjörsutbildning inom relevant teknikområde eller några års arbetslivserfarenhet inom batteriprovning
* Stort tekniskt intresse och vilja att lära dig nya områden.
* Kunskap inom programmering, utveckling av testskript eller automatisering från utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet.
* God problemlösningsförmåga.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Kunskap i Python, LabVIEW eller liknande programmerings- och automationsverktyg.
* Erfarenhet från test-, laboratorie- eller utvecklingsmiljö.
* Kunskap om batterier, elektrifiering eller energisystem.
* Erfarenhet av datainsamling och analys.
* Kunskap om elsystem eller CAN-kommunikation.


**Därför SEEL**
 Hos SEEL får du arbeta i en unik och samhällsviktig testmiljö där kvaliteten i provningen har direkt påverkan på utvecklingen av elektrifierade transporter. Vi erbjuder en stimulerande arbetsplats med hög teknisk kompetens, engagerade kollegor och möjlighet att vara med och forma hur framtidens testning bedrivs.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Låter detta spännande och du vill veta mer så är du välkommen att kontakta Håkan Örnhed, Enhetschef, SEEL, +46 10 516 57 50. Sista ansökningsdag är den 5 oktober 2026. Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.
   

  

 Våra fackliga representanter är; Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-516 51 61, och Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22.

title: Senior Active Directory Specialist
description:
Har du gedigen erfarenhet av att drifta och utveckla Active Directory i affärskritiska miljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och tillgänglighet? Vi söker en senior specialist inom IAM med fokus på Active Directory, som vill vara en del av ett team som arbetar med hela accessområdet. Vill du dessutom arbeta med teknik i framkant inom försvarsindustrin? Nu har du chansen att bli en del av att bidra till säkerheten i Sverige och världen.
 



  





 Denna tjänst i Alvik börjar som ett konsultuppdrag men tanken är att den senare ska gå över i en anställning hos vår kund.
 



  





 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 I rollen som Senior Active Directory Specialist kommer du att ansvara för att säkerställa en stabil och säker AD-miljö genom kontinuerlig drift, övervakning och patchning. Du kommer att arbeta med härdning och säkerhetskonfigurering av Active Directory, hantera behörigheter och delegation samt bidra med expertis i IAM-relaterade frågeställningar. Vidare ingår felsökning och incidenthantering, samt uppsättning och drift av viss infrastruktur.
 



  





 Du kommer även att arbeta proaktivt för att förbättra och effektivisera processer, dokumentation och automatisering, där scripting i PowerShell är en naturlig del av arbetet.
 



  





**Din profil och kvalifikationer** 




 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har en gedigen bakgrund inom Microsofts ekosystem, med djupgående kunskap inom Azure, Microsoft Defender och PowerShell. Du har en förståelse för moderna DevOps-principer och hur nätverksinfrastrukturer i molnet är uppbyggda.
 



 Som person är du nyfiken och engagerad, med en stark vilja att hålla dig uppdaterad inom nya teknologier och säkerhetslösningar. Du har en god kommunikationsförmåga och trivs med att samarbeta i team, samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt och driva projekt framåt.
 



  





*Krav:* 




 • Flerårig erfarenhet av systemadministration i Active Directory
 



 • Djup kunskap inom IAM och identitetshantering
 



 • Förståelse för infrastruktur, nätverk och systemadministration
 



 • Erfarenhet av modern IT-drift, gärna med GitOps-tänk
 



 • Avancerade kunskaper i PowerShell och scripting
 



  





 Erfarenhet av automatisering i större skala är meriterande.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. Vi tycker nämligen att våra medarbetare hela tiden ska fortsätta att utvecklas. Därför erbjuder vi dig möjligheten att lägga upp en individuell utbildningsplan, där vi bekostar såväl studiematerial som själva certifieringarna. Under din utveckling kommer vi matcha din kompetens mot rätt uppdrag i takt med att du avancerar. Vi genomför regelbundet spännande aktiviteter där du som konsult får möjlighet att träffa och umgås med dina kollegor under roliga och avslappnande former.

title: Master thesis: Cost of Portfolio Complexity
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 Ericsson has significantly reduced its Site Material portfolio through standardization initiatives. The next challenge is to understand the true cost impact of the remaining portfolio complexity and identify the optimal balance between cost, standardization, flexibility, and supply resilience. In this master thesis, you will develop a data-driven understanding of how portfolio characteristics influence supply chain costs and help shape future portfolio optimization decisions for Site Material and Global SIPP.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 You will select a Site Material category or portfolio segment and define measurable complexity indicators, such as the number of active items, low-volume items, variants, suppliers, lifecycle maturity, and order frequency. You will analyze the relationship between these indicators and supply chain costs, develop a Cost of Complexity model, and evaluate optimization scenarios including standardization, consolidation, and global product adoption. Your deliverables will include a Portfolio Complexity Framework, a Cost of Complexity Model, quantified cost drivers and optimization opportunities, scenario analyses with business impact assessments, and recommendations for future portfolio governance, including IBP and AI-enabled decision support.
   

  

**The skills you bring:**
* Strong analytical mindset
* Interest in supply chain management, portfolio optimization, data analytics, industrial engineering, business analysis, or a related field
* Good at working with complex datasets, defining meaningful metrics, analyzing cost drivers, and translating findings into practical business recommendations
* Experience with statistical analysis, modeling, scenario planning, or data visualization is an advantage
* You are curious & structured
* Motivated to support more fact-based portfolio decisions


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
   

  

**Primary country and city:** 
 Sweden (SE) || Stockholm
   

  

**Req ID:** 
 791102

title: Software Developer to Qurant – Join our growing health tech team
description:
**About Us**
 Qurant is on a mission to make employee health more proactive, measurable and sustainable.
   

  

 Through our health platform and close collaboration with HR and leadership teams, we help organisations spot early signs of ill health and build healthier workplaces. We are proud of our customer satisfaction and are growing our team to help even more companies make proactive health a natural part of working life.
   

  

 Qurant is an independent company within the Capio Group.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our growing product team.
   

  

 You will work across our product: a Laravel-based web portal used by Swedish employers to manage employee absence and health, as well as a new mobile app currently in development.
   

  

 We are a small team, which means no rigid “web person” or “mobile person” roles. We collaborate, learn from each other and pitch in where the product needs us. You will help build new features, improve performance and reliability, and make thoughtful improvements to an established codebase.
   

  

 As we work with sensitive personal data, quality, security and good engineering practices matter a lot to us.
   

  

****What you’ll do****
* Develop and maintain features across our web portal and mobile app
* Work hands-on with PHP, Laravel, relational databases and integrations
* Improve application and database performance, including queries and indexing
* Navigate technical debt, legacy patterns and ongoing improvements with pragmatism
* Collaborate on code reviews, technical decisions and product development
* Work with Docker, CI/CD and cloud deployments
* Learn new technologies and contribute wherever the team needs you


****We think you’ll thrive here if you have****
* 5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software
* Strong experience with a server-rendered web framework, such as Laravel, Symfony, Rails, Django or ASP.NET Core
* A genuine interest in working with PHP and Laravel day to day
* Solid relational database skills, including query optimisation and performance troubleshooting
* Experience working in existing codebases—not just greenfield projects
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD and a major cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* A collaborative mindset and the confidence to pick up unfamiliar technologies
* Professional fluency in English; Swedish is a strong advantage


****Nice to have**
 Experience with any of the following is a bonus:**
* Flutter, React Native or native mobile development
* GDPR or sensitive personal data in healthcare, finance or another regulated setting
* Multi-tenant SaaS products
* AI coding assistants and agentic workflows
* Livewire, Alpine.js, Blade, Vue, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Kubernetes or PostgreSQL


****For the technically curious (and the proud tech nerds), here’s our stack:****
 Laravel / PHP, Livewire 3, Alpine.js, Blade, Bootstrap 5 / SCSS, MySQL / MariaDB, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions and Azure Container Apps with Bicep.
   

  

 Our mobile app is built in Flutter. We also work with OAuth, webhooks, SFTP-based file flows and integrations such as Försäkringskassan. Some parts of the frontend still use jQuery—because real-life codebases are rarely built in a day.
   

  

****What we offer****
* A meaningful role in a growing health-tech company
* A collaborative team with plenty of room to influence both product and technology
* The chance to work across web, mobile, cloud and integrations
* Central Stockholm offices on Drottninggatan, with hybrid work options


****How to apply****
 Want to help us build healthier workplaces across Sweden? We review applications continuously, so please apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 Start date: autumn or as agreed.
   

  

**Questions?**
 Contact Sandra Jakobsson at
 **sandra.jakobsson@capio.se**

title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Instrumentation SDK (iOS) | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.**
**The Opportunity**
 Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Mobile Observability initiative gives mobile developers first-class instrumentation SDKs that capture traces, metrics, logs, crashes, and user sessions. Our solutions aim to be tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We’re building high-performance, low-overhead SDKs that make it easy for teams to connect mobile signals to backend and infra telemetry for true full-stack visibility.
   

  

 We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Build and evolve mobile instrumentation SDKs for iOS (Swift / Obj-C), prioritizing performance, stability, and a great developer experience.
* Design and ship SDK features such as session tracking, crash reporting, sampling strategies, automatic context propagation, and OpenTelemetry integrations.
* Own projects end-to-end.
* Break large, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables: design modular solutions, ship MVPs, gather feedback, iterate quickly.
* Ensure quality: automated tests, CI, documentation, and smooth, backwards-compatible upgrade paths.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to ensure cohesive end-to-end observability workflows.
* Engage with the open-source community: review PRs, discuss design proposals, and help guide external contributors.
* Mentor teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the mobile observability roadmap.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* You’re a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action and the ability to run with poorly defined scopes. You can operate autonomously while being highly collaborative.
* Strong mobile engineering experience: with iOS (Swift/Obj-C) and, optionally, Android (Kotlin/Java).
* Demonstrated experience building or maintaining mobile SDKs, platform libraries, or other developer-facing platform code used by external developers.
* Experience working with performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, network efficiency) and making pragmatic tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, SDKs, collectors) or experience contributing to/maintaining OTel SDKs or similar telemetry libraries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed team.
* Coachable, customer-focused, and passionate about developer experience, you can do more than code: you write docs, mentor others, and shape roadmaps.
* Pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity: you prioritize progress over perfection and iterate quickly based on feedback.


**Bonus Points For**
* Contributions to OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries, or other observability OSS.
* Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings/bridges.
* Experience with mobile security, privacy, or platform integration challenges.
* Prior work on crash aggregation, session replay, or sampling for mobile telemetry.


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the compensation range for this role is SEK 775,000 - SEK 969,300. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Senior Backend Engineer | Orders Team
description:
**About The Role**
 The Orders team plays an integral role in our organization. As a
 **Senior Backend Engineer** 
 in this core team, you’ll have a significant impact on our overall architecture, technical direction, and company success. Together, we continue to develop one of Sweden’s most widely used delivery services—and you will play a key leadership role in shaping the future of our engineering organization and delivery platforms!
   

  

**Some of the things you will do**
* Architect next-generation systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and performance of our crucial order-handling backbone.
* Integrate AI & modern tech: Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools, smart workflows, and modern technologies to enhance system performance, automated processes, and developer workflows.
* Drive technical strategy & mentor: Partner closely with product management and cross-functional stakeholders to align technical architecture with business goals while mentoring junior and mid-level team members.
* Champion innovation: Stay ahead of industry trends, evaluate new technologies, and introduce best practices that elevate our engineering standards.
* System evolution & optimization: Continuously review, audit, and refactor our distributed architecture to maximize reliability, maintainability, and efficiency.
* Collaborative leadership: Lead by example in an autonomous environment that embraces pair/mob programming, high-standard code reviews, and collective technical problem-solving.


**Your future team**
 The Orders team is responsible for developing and maintaining the core engine of our business: order handling. This involves everything from creating and managing orders to ensuring their successful completion and everything in between. By driving technical excellence in this domain, you will empower and support development teams across Instabee.
   

  

 You will join a focused, high-impact team supported by an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, and a Staff Engineer. We operate with high autonomy, relying on senior expertise to make high-leverage architectural decisions foundational to Instabee's growth.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Senior Engineering Background: Extensive experience as a Senior Backend Engineer designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput systems in modern production environments.
* Core Tech Stack: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
* Deep Database Experience: Deep expertise with MongoDB (or equivalent document/NoSQL/relational database technologies), including query optimization and schema design for high-scale applications.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and production experience with GCP (Google Cloud Platform) or similar cloud infrastructure.
* AI Savvy: A forward-thinking, proactive approach to leveraging AI capabilities, LLMs, or developer automation to optimize backend engineering and business operations.
* Technical Leadership & Learning: A continuous-learning mindset paired with the ability to drive technical initiatives from conception to delivery.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly articulate complex architectural concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.


**You don’t need to know every technology in our stack on day one—we value your problem-solving ability, curiosity, and adaptability over checking every single box.**
**What You’ll Get**
 We promise you’ll be challenged, rapidly expand your technical reach, and work alongside deeply talented colleagues. If you thrive in high-ownership, adaptable environments and enjoy setting technical direction and best practices, Instabee is the place for you.
   

  

**Alongside Standard Competitive Benefits, We Offer**
 🌇
 **Sky-High Office:** 
 Modern, newly renovated office with a 360-degree view of Stockholm.
   

  

 🐶
 **Puppy Friendly:** 
 Bring your dog to work—we have a dedicated floor for our furry friends!
   

  

 🏓
 **Fun & Games:** 
 Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.
   

  

 👶
 **Parental Top-Up:** 
 6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Off:** 
 Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flexible Hybrid Setup:** 
 Working hours designed to adapt to your life.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of logistics with us?**
 If you're a senior engineer who loves solving complex backend challenges, experimenting with modern tech, and making an impact at scale, we’d love to meet you. Send in your application and let’s start the conversation!
   

  

**Diversity & Inclusion**
 Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of our culture. We are committed to building an inclusive work environment where every perspective is valued and every team member has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

**Get to know us**
 Founded in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox, Instabee brings together three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy.  As our logistics network and business complexity expand across Scandinavia and continental Europe, we need senior engineering talent ready to architect for scale and build the future with us.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Be visionary**
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.
   

  

 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   

  

**Job Description**
**FLIR Digital Solutions, Täby**
 Vill du vara med och definiera framtidens mjukvaruplattform för termisk bildteknik? Vi söker en erfaren mjukvaruarkitekt som vill ta ett tekniskt ledarskap inom vårt SDK-team, med fokus på att driva utvecklingen av bildbehandling, hårdvaruacceleration och AI.

Du får ett stort inflytande över arkitektur, teknikval och den långsiktiga utvecklingen av bildkedjan i ett SDK som används för att kommunicera med och hantera bilddata från Flirs värmekameror. Du blir en central kontaktpunkt för andra utvecklingsteam och hjälper till att säkerställa att SDK:t möter kraven från både befintliga och framtida produkter.
   

  

 Teamet består av tio utvecklare och testare och är huvudsakligen baserat i Täby.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Ansvara för arkitektur och teknisk riktning för AI-integration och bildbehandling inom vårt SDK.
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla C++-baserade lösningar för Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS och Android.
* Driva arbete kring prestandaoptimering och hårdvaruaccelererad bildbehandling.
* Stötta interna och externa team i integration och användning av SDK:t.
* Identifiera och implementera förbättringar baserat på krav från produkter och integratörer.
* Säkerställa att SDK:t är modernt, skalbart och väl anpassat för framtida behov.
* Samarbeta nära utvecklare, produktägare och andra tekniska intressenter.


**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Mycket goda kunskaper i C++.
* Djup erfarenhet av bildbehandling.
* Erfarenhet av GPU-programmering och hårdvaruacceleration, exempelvis med CUDA, OpenCL, Metal, Vulkan eller motsvarande tekniker.
* Erfarenhet från en arkitektroll eller annat tekniskt ledarskap.


**Meriterande**
* Master-examen eller motsvarande erfarenhet inom relevant område, t.ex. signalbehandling, datateknik.
* Erfarenhet av att implementera och produktionssätta AI-modeller i kommersiella produkter.
* Erfarenhet av multiplattformsutveckling (Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS och Android)
* Erfarenhet av prestandamätning och prestandaoptimering
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, agentiska AI-workflows, uppkopplade produkter, optiska sensorer och kamerasystem


**Vi erbjuder**
 Hos Flir Digital Solutions får du möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad teknik där mjukvara, AI och bildbehandling möter verkliga produkter. Du får stort inflytande över tekniska beslut, arbetar tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och bidrar direkt till nästa generations lösningar inom termisk bildteknik.
   

  

**Nästa steg**
 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Efter att du skickat in din ansökan får du information om nästa steg i processen. Rekryterande chef är Isac Strömberg.
   

  

*Placering: Täby. Rollen kräver arbete på plats på kontoret.*
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

title: Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Engineer Remote Connectivity and IoT** 
 to help us build secure, reliable, and scalable connectivity solutions for products used in the field.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who really understands IoT and remote connectivity, not just in theory, but in practice. We’re looking for a senior technical person who can help define how we should build connected solutions going forward, while also being comfortable getting into the details when needed.
   

  

 You work closely with backend developers and a Product Owner focused on remote connectivity. You’ll act as a technical expert in the team, supporting both roadmap discussions and day-to-day technical decisions.
   

  

 Location: Sundbyberg, Sweden.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and improve secure and reliable connectivity solutions for products connected to cloud platforms and remote systems.
* Work with connectivity architecture, remote access, integration, performance, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Take a broad technical view of the solution landscape and help define how connectivity should be designed going forward.
* Evaluate current ways of working and contribute to improved technical approaches, principles, and solution design.
* Dive into technical details when needed to understand how solutions are built today and how they can be strengthened over time.
* Support the manager and product owner with technical direction, architecture input, and solution design.
* Act as a senior technical expert who helps guide decisions and supports the team in building strong, scalable solutions.


**Qualifications**
* A degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, or similar
* Solid experience in IoT connectivity and remote access solutions
* Strong understanding of connected product architecture
* Experience designing scalable, reliable connectivity solutions
* Good knowledge of networking and protocols such as MQTT, TCP/IP, VPN, cellular, and ideally 5G
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure — cloud is especially important in this role
* Good understanding of cybersecurity for connected devices and systems
* Experience from products that send data from the field to backend or cloud platforms
* Ability to contribute to technical direction and architecture decisions
* Strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mindset
* Ability to explain technical topics in a clear and practical way
* Fluent in English both spoken and written


**It’s also a plus if you have**
* Experience in backend development, for example Java/Spring Boot
* Experience from critical infrastructure or other industries with high demands on security and uptime


 We believe you have worked as a senior engineer, system architect, or product architect within IoT, connectivity, or connected products. You probably have experience from products that are already on the market and used in real environments.
   

  

 You might have worked with systems in water, pump stations, drinking water, energy, healthcare, automotive, industrial equipment, or other critical infrastructure. Exact industry is less important than having experience from connected products in real-world use.
   

  

**Why Work at Xylem!**
 We offer you a creative and international environment where you get the opportunity to focus on your personal and professional development together with committed and helpful colleagues. Engage as a volunteer through Xylem´s business program for community initiatives Xylem Watermark: www.xylemwatermark.com
 **.**
**Everyone's equal value**
 We want people, regardless of skin color, age, disability, sexual orientation and gender identity, to feel at home, not just on Xylem, but everywhere in the world. For us, diversity means more than just a policy or a set of methods. Diversity is a fundamental part of our corporate culture and a key to long-term growth.
   

  

 Feel free to visit us at https://www.xylem.com/sv-se/
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application in English. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process if we find the right candidate.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Leila Sayyad, Leila.sayyad@xylem.com.
   

  

 We only accept applicants through Sök efter jobb
 **.**
 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: ERP-Specialist
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla hur ERP stöttar verksamheten?
   

  

 På Svea Solar befinner vi oss mitt i en transformationsresa där IT går från traditionell systemförvaltning till att bli en aktiv möjliggörare för verksamheten. Vi har en tydlig ambition att kraftigt öka automationsgraden genom hela kundresan. Vi utvecklar därför hur våra plattformar samverkar, med målet att allt fler processer kring exempelvis kundupplägg, projekt, inköp, fakturering och ekonomiska transaktioner ska kunna ske automatiskt.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en erfaren ERP-specialist med gedigen kompetens inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central till vårt Group IT-team i Stockholm.
   

  

 Låter det som nästa utmaning för dig?
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du kommer att arbeta hands-on i Business Central samtidigt som du får möjlighet att ta ansvar för förbättringar och driva initiativ framåt. Salesforce är en central del av vår kommersiella plattform, medan Business Central har en viktig roll när kundresan går vidare mot leverans och ekonomi.
   

  

 Du blir en del av Group IT och arbetar nära vår befintliga ERP-kompetens, Finance och teamen som ansvarar för Salesforce, integration och automation.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som som tillsammans med teamet vill förbättra, förenkla och automatisera hur våra ERP-processer stödjer verksamheten.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Förvalta och vidareutveckla vår Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central-miljö
* Driva förbättringar och automatisering av ekonomi- och ERP-relaterade processer
* Arbeta med initiativ inom exempelvis e-faktura, bankintegrationer och automatiserade ekonomiflöden
* Vara med och utveckla integrationerna mellan Salesforce, Business Central och andra system
* Översätta verksamhetens behov till skalbara och långsiktigt hållbara ERP-lösningar
* Identifiera manuella processer och hitta möjligheter att förenkla eller automatisera dem
* Bedöma när vi bör använda standardfunktionalitet, konfiguration, integration eller anpassad utveckling
* Arbeta nära Finance och andra delar av verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar
* Testa, dokumentera och hjälpa till att ta förbättringar hela vägen till produktion


 🌍 Life as a Power Shifter - Vad erbjuder vi dig
   

  

* Möjligheten att Make an Impact – ditt arbete bidrar direkt till att fixa planeten och driva energiomställningen.
* En värderingsdriven arbetsplats - läs mer om våra värderingar här.
* Chansen att äga dina resultat - – väx, ta ansvar och power up i takt med att vi och energibranschen utvecklas.
* En inkluderande kultur - olika perspektiv driver innovation, hos oss kan du vara dig själv och bidra med dina erfarenheter, identiteter och idéer.
* Trygga villkor - Tjänstepension, 30 semesterdagar, friskvårdsbidrag, parkering m.m.


 Vill du se hur livet hos oss faktiskt ser ut? Följ oss på Instagram: @LifeAtSveaSolar
   

  

 Är vi en match?
   

  

 Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta hands-on med Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV. Du förstår både systemet och affärsprocesserna bakom det och känner dig trygg i gränslandet mellan IT och ekonomi.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara utvecklare för att lyckas i rollen. Det viktiga är att du har en djup förståelse för Business Central och kan bidra till hur processer, data och integrationer bör struktureras för att skapa långsiktigt hållbara lösningar
   

  

 Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central eller Dynamics NAV
* Ekonomi- och redovisningsprocesser
* Integrationer och API kopplade till ERP
* Miljöer med flera bolag eller juridiska enheter
* Processautomation
* E-faktura, betalningsflöden och bankintegrationer
* Kravställning och lösningsdesign
* Test och implementation


 Meriterande:
   

  

 Erfarenhet av Salesforce, integrationsplattformar eller automationsverktyg, exempelvis Power Automate, är meriterande men inget krav.
   

  

 Listan kan kännas lång, men ingen är bäst i alla kategorier. Sök om du känner igen dig någorlunda.😊
   

  

 ⚡Vilka vi är
   

  

 Svea Solar är en av Sveriges - och en av Europas - ledande aktörer inom energiteknik samt leverantör av solenergi och smarta energilösningar. Vi hjälper våra kunder att optimera sin energianvändning med solpaneler, värmepumpar, batterier, laddboxar, elavtal och vår egen mjukvara. Vi kallar det
 **The Power Shift.** 
 Och vi som driver det framåt?
 **Power Shifters.**
**Om vår rekryteringsprocess**
* Alla kandidater bedöms på lika villkor, med strukturerade frågor och tester via Alva Labs för att säkerställa en rättvis och inkluderande process.
* Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.


 👉
 **Redo att bli en Power Shifter?** 
 Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din!

title: Linux System Administrator
description:
We at WeQuel are now looking for an experienced Linux System Administrator in Södertälje. You will be a key part of the customer's infrastructure organization, focusing on automation, architecture and platform engineering. You will design, build and maintain a GPU-accelerated Remote Desktop (VDI) environment that supports pre- and post-processing of HPC workloads, including automotive simulations, visualization and rendering. The platform runs on Rocky Linux / RHEL, uses X11 and Xfce4, and uses NICE DCV, EF Portal (EnginFrame) and SLURM to deliver high-performance graphical sessions remotely.
   

  

 As a consultant with us, you get to work with one of our customers, who are leading companies in automotive, industry and engineering. You will help build scalable, secure and sustainable platforms, drive automation and put new technology into practice.
   

  

**Your responsibilities:**
* Designing, deploying and maintaining a Linux-based, GPU-enabled Remote Desktop environment (DCV, EnginFrame, SLURM, X11, Xfce4 on Rocky Linux)
* Developing automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), mainly with Ansible
* Keeping deployments consistent and repeatable
* Securing the platform and keeping it scalable, fast and maintainable over time
* Working closely with the HPC and Infrastructure Engineering teams
* Documenting architecture, configurations, deployment workflows and operating procedures


 You will work in a technically advanced environment where you own complex systems yourself and work closely with several teams across the organization.
   

  

**Requirements:**
* Solid experience as a Linux System Administrator, ideally with Rocky Linux or RHEL
* Strong automation and IaC skills, preferably Ansible or similar
* Scripting skills, mainly Bash (Python is a plus)
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git, GitLab)
* Understanding of X11, desktop environments (Xfce4, GNOME) and remote rendering/display protocols
* Good knowledge of networking, security and monitoring tools, preferably Prometheus-based observability
* Strong architectural mindset, able to design scalable and maintainable systems
* Able to work independently and take ownership of complex environments
* Comfortable working onsite in Södertälje


**Nice to have:**
* Experience with HPC environments and the SLURM workload manager
* Experience with NICE DCV, EnginFrame (EF Portal), Open OnDemand or similar remote visualization platforms
* Familiarity with container technologies (Docker, Podman)
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools


**Assignment details:**
* Start: 2026-10-01
* End: 2027-12-31
* Location: Södertälje
* Workload: 100%
* Remote: up to 40% (onsite every Monday, Tuesday and Friday; the assignment may require up to 100% onsite, five days a week)


**We offer:**
 At WeQuel, you become part of a consulting team that puts people first. We believe success comes from engagement, collaboration and growth. We offer a flat organization with short decision paths, a strong sense of community and the chance to shape your own development.
