title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it:
   

  

* The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 4 (Senior). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 82,500 SEK per month + $180,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 90,000 SEK per month + $120,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 97,500 SEK per month + $60,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you're earlier in your journey than this role expects, that's not a problem. Apply to the Fullstack Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

title: System Engineer
description:
Lockas du av tekniska utmaningar där lösningen inte är given från början? Här får du arbeta med avancerade system där mjukvara, nätverk och andra tekniska komponenter behöver fungera tillsammans. Du får sätta din problemlösningsförmåga på prov, gå på djupet i komplexa problem och följa felsökningen hela vägen fram till en fungerande lösning.
 



  





**Om tjänsten:** 




 Som systemingenjör blir du en del av ett högteknologiskt företag som utvecklar avancerade tekniska system för komplexa miljöer. Du arbetar med test, integration, konfiguration och teknisk felsökning och bidrar till att olika delar av systemen fungerar tillsammans.
 



  





 En del av arbetet handlar om att sätta upp och testa mjukvara i olika systemmiljöer. När något inte fungerar som förväntat behöver du undersöka varför. Ligger problemet i mjukvaran, konfigurationen, nätverket, hårdvaran eller kommunikationen mellan olika system?
 



  





 Du arbetar stegvis med felsökningen för att identifiera orsaken och komma fram till en lösning.
 



 Du arbetar även med nätverk, simulatorer och gränssnitt mot andra tekniska produkter. Ibland behöver du läsa och tolka kod för att förstå systemets beteende, men detta är inte primärt en utvecklarroll. Fokus ligger på systemförståelse, test, integration och teknisk problemlösning.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter:** 



* Testa, konfigurera och integrera mjukvara i tekniska systemmiljöer
* Felsöka mjukvara, nätverk och tekniska gränssnitt
* Undersöka systembeteenden och identifiera orsaken till problem
* Konfigurera mjukvara och nätverk
* Drifta och felsöka simulatorer
* Hantera gränssnitt och kommunikation mellan olika tekniska system
* Samarbeta nära med integratörer, testare och mjukvaruutvecklare
* Dokumentera konfigurationer, felsökningar och genomförda förändringar



  





 Arbetet sker huvudsakligen på kontoret och i företagets test- och referensanläggningar. Vid vissa tillfällen kan du även arbeta i andra tekniska miljöer, exempelvis ombord på fartyg. Resor inom Sverige och utomlands förekommer.
 



  





 Vi söker dig som:
 


* Har minst 3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT eller teknik
* Har erfarenhet av test, teknisk felsökning, mjukvara, IT-drift, nätverk eller systemintegration
* Är van att självständigt sätta dig in i tekniska system och driva problemlösning framåt
* Behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift



  





 Erfarenhet av Linux, nätverk, systemtest, testautomation, simulatorer eller integration mellan hårdvara och mjukvara är meriterande. Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga områden.
 



 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är tekniskt nyfiken och tycker om att förstå varför något inte fungerar. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt men trivs samtidigt med att samarbeta, diskutera tekniska problem och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra.
 



  





**Om anställningen:** 




 Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du kommer att vara anställd av Friday och arbeta som konsult ute hos vår kund.
 



  





 Denna tjänst kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar med krav på säkerhetsklassificering kan säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll genomföras enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen. Säkerhetsklassningen kan även medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
 



  





**Övrig information:** 




 Omfattning: Heltid
 



 Start: Omgående
 



 Placering: Stockholm
 



 Rekryteringsansvarig: Maja Dahlin (maja.dahlin@friday.se) & Axel Stubbing (axel.stubbing@friday.se)
 



 Lön: Fast månadslön
 



  





 Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval och annonsen kan stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt.
 



  





**Om Friday:** 




 På Friday brinner vi för att hjälpa dig att ta nästa steg i din karriär inom IT och teknik. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi arbetar med både rekrytering och konsultlösningar inom IT och teknik och finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro.

title: Plattformsansvarig IAM – forma framtida identitets- och åtkomststrategi
description:
Vill du vara med och forma Huddinge kommuns framtida arbete med identitet och åtkomst? Vi söker en erfaren och strategiskt orienterad Plattformsansvarig (Objektproduktledare IT – PM3) som vill ta ett helhetsgrepp om identitet och behörighet (IAM) och utveckla hur kommunen ska arbeta med området.
   

  

 Du kommer in i ett spännande skede där vi genomför en tydlig förflyttning – från att själva ta ett stort operativt ansvar inom IAM till att i högre grad vara beställare, sätta riktning och styra våra leverantörer. Du får en central roll i att forma denna förflyttning och etablera ett långsiktigt, skalbart och tjänstebaserat arbetssätt.
   

  

**Om avdelningen**
 Digitaliseringsavdelningen på Huddinge kommun består av sektionerna Arkitektur och Innovation, Samordnad verksamhetsutveckling, Digital drift samt Digitalt stöd. Vi är cirka 80 medarbetare och leds av framtidsdirektören som rapporterar till kommundirektören och ingår i kommunens ledningsgrupp.
   

  

 IAM är en central del av kommunens systemarkitektur. Under de kommande åren är målsättningen att etablera en ny plattform med tillhörande styrning, arkitektur och leveransmodell.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Huddinge kommun har under många år byggt upp en IAM-plattform som hanterar merparten av kommunens konton och system. Digitaliseringsavdelningen ansvarar idag för arkitektur, design och säkerhet samt nyttjar externa leverantörer för utveckling och förvaltning. Nu är vi redo att ta nästa steg!
   

  

 Huddinge kommun har en tydlig strategi att i större utsträckning konsumera IT som tjänst. Inom identitet och behörighet innebär det att våra leverantörer i högre grad ska ansvara för den operativa leveransen, medan vi fokuserar på riktning, kravställning och uppföljning.
   

  

 Som Plattformsansvarig för IAM får du en nyckelroll i denna förändring. Du kommer att forma kommunens framtida arbetssätt och styrning och vara en kvalificerad motpart till våra leverantörer.
   

  

**I uppdraget ingår att:**
* Ta ett helhetsansvar för kommunens arbete med identitet och behörighet.
* Vidareutveckla kommunens identitets- och behörighetsstrategi.
* Identifiera vilka förmågor kommunen behöver ha själva och vilka som kan konsumeras som tjänst.
* Vara beställare och kravställare gentemot leverantörer samt följa upp leveransen.
* Omsätta verksamhetens behov till krav, prioriteringar och utvecklingsinitiativ.
* Säkerställa att området utvecklas i linje med arkitektur, informationssäkerhet och digitaliseringsstrategi.
* Vara rådgivande part till verksamhet, arkitektur och informationssäkerhet.
* Identifiera och prioritera utvecklingsområden inom exempelvis identitetslivscykel, behörighetsstyrning och autentisering.
* Driva och samordna initiativ samt omvärldsbevaka området.
* Utveckla ansvar, gränssnitt, styrmodeller, processer och arbetssätt.
* Bidra till utveckling av kommunens förmåga inom identitet och behörighet.


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har bred erfarenhet inom IT och vill ta nästa steg i din karriär. Du kan se helheten, förstå komplexa sammanhang och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tydlig riktning och lösningar.
   

  

 Du kan exempelvis ha en bakgrund som IT-arkitekt, projektledare, projektägare, förvaltningsledare eller produktledare men det viktigaste är inte vilken titel du haft. Vi söker framför allt dig som kan förstå området, se helheten och driva utvecklingen framåt och att du har erfarenhet av att driva komplexa frågor framåt, skapa struktur och få olika intressenter att samlas kring en gemensam riktning.
   

  

 IAM är ett viktigt område i rollen och du behöver ha förståelse för identitet, åtkomst och behörighetsstyrning. Vi ser gärna att du har arbetat med IAM eller närliggande områden och har intresse för hur området behöver utvecklas i en modern kommunal IT-miljö.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av att leda eller driva förändrings- och utvecklingsinitiativ.
* Erfarenhet av utvecklings- och förvaltningsplaner.
* Erfarenhet av beställarroll, kravställning och leverantörsstyrning.
* Erfarenhet av outsourcade eller tjänstebaserade IT-leveranser är meriterande.
* Förståelse för IT-arkitektur, informationssäkerhet och IT-styrning.
* Erfarenhet från större organisation, kommun eller annan offentlig verksamhet är meriterande.
* Kunskap om ITIL och/eller PM3 är meriterande.
* Mycket god samverkans- och kommunikationsförmåga.
* En lösningsorienterad och pragmatisk personlighet.


 Vi tror att du är nyfiken, trygg i din kompetens och motiveras av att utveckla teknik och arbetssätt. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – men du behöver ha förmågan och viljan att förstå området, ställa rätt frågor och forma vägen framåt tillsammans med andra.
   

  

 Vidare har du förmågan att ta ansvar, driva frågor självständigt och skapa framdrift även när vägen framåt inte är given. Du kan växla mellan helikopterperspektiv och detaljer och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos interna och externa parter.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering kommer bakgrundskontroll samt säkerhetsintervju genomföras på slutkandidat.
   

  

 Om arbetsplatsen
   

  

 Värderar du närhet, att växa och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för alla som bor och verkar i Huddinge kommun? Då erbjuder vi mängder av karriärmöjligheter i en välfungerande och växande kommun med både natur och storstadspuls runt hörnet. Hos oss känner du dig trygg, delaktig och stolt när vi med kraft gör skillnad, varje dag. I Huddinge kommun arbetar vi för att skapa ett hållbart samhälle, där natur, teknik och god service samspelar. Huddinge är en stor Stockholmskommun med cirka 6 400 medarbetare och fler än 110 000 invånare.
   

  

 Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen.
   

  

 Huddinge kommun arbetar för att vara en trygg, rättssäker och professionell verksamhet. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi därför komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller och begära registerutdrag i slutskedet av vissa rekryteringar. Om du blir aktuell för detta får du tydlig information och möjlighet att lämna ditt samtycke innan kontrollen genomförs.

* Erfarenhet av MySQL och / eller MariaDB

 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

 På Eccera får du de verktyg du behöver för att nå dina mål. Vi erbjuder alla våra konsulter kvalificerade utbildningar och certifieringar inom den senaste tekniken. title: Integration and Data Architect
description:
Vi söker fler Integration & Data‑arkitekter som vill arbeta i miljöer där teknik, verksamhet och säkerhet möts. Hos oss får du arbeta långsiktigt, nära kundens kärnverksamhet - i uppdrag där din expertis gör stor skillnad för både affären och helheten.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en trygg och professionell miljö där samarbete, kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt står i centrum.
   

  

**Är du den vi söker?**
 Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:
   

  

* designa och implementera robusta integrationslösningar
* arbeta med modern eventdriven arkitektur
* skapa tydliga API-strukturer och flöden som håller över tid
* analysera verksamhetsprocesser och omsätta dem i tekniska lösningar
* etablera principer, mallar och referensarkitektur
* guida team i CI/CD, IaC och goda integrationsmönster


 Du behöver inte vara expert på allt - vi söker dig som är trygg, nyfiken och gillar att ta ansvar för helheten.
   

  

**Vad du kan arbeta med hos oss**
 Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag, men kan inkludera:
   

  

**Integrationsarkitektur**
* design och implementation i Azure Integration Services
* API-design (REST, eventdrivet, hybridlösningar)
* patterns för köer, pub/sub, integrationsplattformar och pipelines


**Data & Flöden**
* ETL/ELT, datakvalitet och optimering av dataflöden
* analys av systemlandskap och informationsmodeller
* monitoreringsstrategier och operational readiness


**Dev & CI/CD**
* CI/CD-relaterat arbete i Azure DevOps
* infrastructure as code och automatiserad deployment
* teststrategier för integration och flöden


**Verksamhetsnära arkitektur**
* workshops och behovsinsamling
* stöd inför upphandlingar och tekniska vägval
* affärsförståelse inom energi, bank/finans, industri, offentlig sektor m.m.


**Vilka vi tror att du är**
 Vi tror att du:
   

  

* gillar att skapa tydlighet i komplexa systemlandskap
* har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tekniska beslut
* är trygg i rollen och trivs nära både utveckling och verksamhet
* är prestigelös, inkluderande och värdesätter teamets framgång
* är nyfiken på nya tekniker och arbetssätt, t.ex. AI‑drivna verktyg
* vill arbeta långsiktigt och hållbart, tillsammans med andra


 Hos oss behöver du inte passa in i en mall. Vi tror på olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv - och vi vill att du ska kunna växa på det sätt som passar dig.
   

  

**Trygga uppdrag där din kompetens behövs på riktigt**
 Som Integration & Data Architect hos oss får du arbeta i uppdrag som är:
   

  

* affärskritiska – där data och flöden är centrala för verksamheten
* långsiktiga – med tid att göra det rätt, inte bara snabbt
* moderna – med Azure, moln, automatisering och nya arbetssätt
* stabila – med erfarna team och kunder som litar på oss


 Vi matchar dig utifrån din kompetens och dina ambitioner — inte mot första lediga uppdrag.
   

  

 🚀
 **Vi satsar på dig**
 Hos oss får du:
   

  

* kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och certifieringar
* gemenskap och kunskapsdelning genom interna kompetensdagar
* möjlighet att påverka teknik, arkitektur och arbetssätt i uppdrag
* en kultur av omtanke, kvalitet och nyfikenhet
* kollegor som gärna delar med sig, sparrar och stöttar


 Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar värde - för kunden, samhället och framtiden.
   

  

 💚
 **Om oss**
 Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 800 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

title: Inside Sales Engineer - Nordics & Baltics
description:

You will contribute directly to strengthening our market presence and growing sales of vacuum pumps, components and service solutions.
**Your day-to-day**

title: Platform Engineering Leader
description:
**Company Description**  

Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

  

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As a Platform Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.


Inter IKEA Group is organised in three core businesses - Range, Supply and Retail Concept - and five enabling functions. Together we contribute to the success of IKEA and share responsibility for the franchise offer.


The enabling functions lead key common activities in networks across Inter IKEA Group, as well as cover specific needs for the core businesses. The five Enabling functions are Operations Management, Business Performance & Support, Communication, Sustainability and People & Culture.

 **Job Description**  

As a Platform Engineering Leader, you’ll help shape how engineering work comes together across multiple teams by creating alignment, spotting opportunities to reuse great ideas, and championing best practices that make our platforms stronger. You’ll work closely with Architecture to ensure our technical solutions—including those leveraging cloud technologies, AI capabilities and automation—connect seamlessly across products and platforms, supporting performance, reusability and broader business goals. With your understanding of the IKEA business model and its technology landscape, you’ll guide teams to improve information flow and ensure engineering work is both effective and meaningful.


You’ll also play a key role in building a collaborative and inclusive engineering culture—driving adoption of smart design patterns, promoting shared technology platforms and modern cloud‑ and AI‑driven approaches, and avoiding duplicated effort through thoughtful automation. As an ambassador for platform engineering, you’ll onboard new engineers, explore emerging technologies, and recommend improvements that enhance performance, reliability and efficiency. As a senior voice in the wider technology community, you’ll represent IKEA both internally and externally, helping shape the future of engineering across the organisation.

 **Qualifications**  

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about delivering high‑quality platforms and technology within complex ecosystems, and who loves exploring new ideas and innovations.


With a solid foundation in network architecture, base infrastructure, platform engineering and service management, you navigate cloud, hybrid and on-prem environments with ease.


You treat physical and network deployments with a software engineering mindset at scale. This includes Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, etc.), network virtualization, and high levels of automation.


You easily understand and navigate with terms as ZTNA, identity-based access, micro-segmentation and SASE, to protect our global value chain. You are experienced with modern technologies like SD-WAN, wireless, and data centre networking. On top of that you understand the need of highly automated base infra such as DNS/DHCP/IPAM is highly available and automated


You thrive in a fast-changing environment and bring a growth mindset, exploring, learning, and sharing better ways forward. Above all, you lead with IKEA values and use technology to enable “a better everyday life for the many.”


You’ll thrive in an environment where agility, curiosity, and adaptability are valued—whether you’re working independently or as part of a cross‑functional team. With a mindset focused on simplicity, efficiency, and accountability, you’ll actively seek out new skills, champion fresh methods, and help shape new digital ways of working that improve performance and inspire others.


You’ll bring strong interpersonal and communication skills, enabling you to build trusted relationships and explain technical concepts clearly to a wide range of audiences, from team members to suppliers. Motivated by helping others grow, you’ll contribute to developing technical competence across teams while leading with confidence through change and new strategic directions. Most importantly, you’ll embrace and share the IKEA culture and values, understanding how technology plays an essential role in our unique business and helping create an inclusive environment where people support one another and succeed together.


This role requires strong knowledge and hands‑on experience in cloud technologies, AI solutions and automation to drive smarter, more efficient ways of working.


To be successful in this role, the following knowledge, skills and experiences would be valuable:

* Extensive knowledge of Modern networking & connectivity: Strong understanding of cloud/hybrid ecosystems, including SD-WAN, SASE, and high-availability global connectivity for fast-scaling retail and distribution environments.
* Zero-Trust & secure edge: Deep experience in identity-aware access models, micro-segmentation, and secure infra to build a secure perimeter by design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Using tools like Terraform to automate physical and network deployments, ensuring our foundation is version-controlled and repeatable.
* Foundational Compute & Core Services: Solid understanding of data centre operations and core services like DNS/DHCP/IPAM and load balancing managed as mission-critical products.
* Experience working with agile frameworks, scaled delivery models and IT service operations.
* Use of metrics and OKRs to measure impact and drive continuous improvement.
* Proven track record of leading technical teams, formal or informal
* Experience with risk, compliance, and regulatory requirements for global infrastructure.
* And last but not least a natural and genuine easy going way of communication and meeting with all IKEA stakeholders in a humble but straightforward way.

 **Additional Information**  

This is a full-time role (40-hours per week) based in Malmö, Sweden and reports to the Platform Manager for Connectivity & base infrastructure.


Ready to assemble your next step?  

Submit your CV and let us know why you would be a good fit by the 7th of October 2026.


Please also note that we only handle applications in English and do not accept applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please connect with Calvin Blyth (calvin.byth2@inter.ikea.com).


At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs. At IKEA, we’re all on the same project.


If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer - Instrumentation SDK (iOS) | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.


**This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants based in Spain, Ireland, Germany, the UK or Sweden at this time.**


**The Opportunity:**



Grafana Observability builds end-to-end observability that spans application, infrastructure, database, browser, and mobile. Our Mobile Observability initiative gives mobile developers first-class instrumentation SDKs that capture traces, metrics, logs, crashes, and user sessions. Our solutions aim to be tightly integrated with OpenTelemetry and Grafana Cloud. We’re building high-performance, low-overhead SDKs that make it easy for teams to connect mobile signals to backend and infra telemetry for true full-stack visibility.



We value open standards, great developer experience, and doing the hard engineering needed to ship reliable software at scale. You may not meet every requirement below. If this role excites you, please raise your hand.


**What You’ll Be Doing:**


* Build and evolve mobile instrumentation SDKs for iOS (Swift / Obj-C), prioritizing performance, stability, and a great developer experience.
* Design and ship SDK features such as session tracking, crash reporting, sampling strategies, automatic context propagation, and OpenTelemetry integrations.
* Own projects end-to-end.
* Break large, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables: design modular solutions, ship MVPs, gather feedback, iterate quickly.
* Ensure quality: automated tests, CI, documentation, and smooth, backwards-compatible upgrade paths.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, frontend, product, and solutions engineering to ensure cohesive end-to-end observability workflows.
* Engage with the open-source community: review PRs, discuss design proposals, and help guide external contributors.
* Mentor teammates, participate in technical design discussions and help shape the mobile observability roadmap.


**What Makes You a Great Fit:**


* You’re a motivated self-starter with a bias toward action and the ability to run with poorly defined scopes. You can operate autonomously while being highly collaborative.
* Strong mobile engineering experience: with iOS (Swift/Obj-C) and, optionally, Android (Kotlin/Java).
* Demonstrated experience building or maintaining mobile SDKs, platform libraries, or other developer-facing platform code used by external developers.
* Experience working with performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, network efficiency) and making pragmatic tradeoffs.
* Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (instrumentation, SDKs, collectors) or experience contributing to/maintaining OTel SDKs or similar telemetry libraries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Comfortable working in a fully remote, globally distributed team.
* Coachable, customer-focused, and passionate about developer experience, you can do more than code: you write docs, mentor others, and shape roadmaps.
* Pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity: you prioritize progress over perfection and iterate quickly based on feedback.


**Bonus Points For:**


* Contributions to OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries, or other observability OSS.
* Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings/bridges.
* Experience with mobile security, privacy, or platform integration challenges.
* Prior work on crash aggregation, session replay, or sampling for mobile telemetry.


**Compensation & Rewards:**



In Sweden, the compensation range for this role is SEK 775,000 - SEK 969,300. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.



#LI-Remote


* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote



*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

title: Universitetsadjunkt i datavetenskap (programmering och datorsystemteknik)
description:
Blekinge Tekniska Högskola är en plats för nyfikenhet och uppfinningsrikedom med campus mitt i den blekingska skärgården. Här erbjuder vi utbildning från grundnivå till doktorsexamen och bedriver tillämpad forskning i världsklass. Vi förändrar och gör skillnad. Vill du bli en av oss?
  
  

Institutionen för datavetenskap är en av två institutioner vid fakulteten för datavetenskaper. Den är BTH: s största institution med drygt 70 personer. Vid institutionen bedrivs forskning inom området datavetenskap. Det innehåller delområdena big data och AI, parallella datorsystem, visuell och interaktiv datavetenskap samt säkerhet och distribuerade system.
  
  

Arbetsbeskrivning
  
I anställningen ingår undervisning på kandidat- och magisternivå inom datavetenskap, med fokus på praktiska moment såsom laborationer och projekt. Handledning av studenter inom ämnesområdet, bland annat examensarbeten, kan också ingå.
  
  

Anställningen är inriktad mot undervisning och handledning inom dels programmering (objektorienterad programmering, algoritmer och datastrukturer samt databaser, både relationsdatabaser och NoSQL), dels distribuerade system och cloud computing (virtualisering och containerisering, molnplattformar samt hantering och behandling av data i molnmiljöer). Undervisning kan också förväntas i angränsande områden.
  
  

Anställningen kan också innehålla administrativa uppgifter samt vidareutveckling av befintliga kurser och utveckling av nya kurser. Även samverkan med det omgivande samhället förekommer som en del av anställningen.
  
  

Internationella sökande ska initialt kunna undervisa på engelska. Sökande utan goda kunskaper i svenska förväntas inhämta sådana kunskaper och undervisa på svenska inom tre år från anställningen.
  
  

Behörighetskrav
  
  

**Behörig att anställas som universitetsadjunkt är den som har:**  

avlagt högskoleexamen på minst 180 högskolepoäng eller har motsvarande kompetens eller har någon annan skicklighet som är av betydelse med hänsyn till anställningens ämnesinnehåll och de arbetsuppgifter som ska ingå i anställningen,
  
visat pedagogisk skicklighet.
  
  

Behörighetskraven och bedömningskriterierna beskrivs i detalj i BTH: s ”Riktlinjer för anställning och befordran av lärare och utnämning till docent”, som finns på https://www.bth.se/om-bth/jobba-hos-oss/lediga-jobb.
  
  

Meriterande kompetenser och erfarenheter
  
Utöver kraven som beskrivs i arbetsbeskrivningen, behörighetskraven och bedömningskriterierna för anställningen, anses följande examina, kompetenser och erfarenheter meriterande:
  
Dokumenterad undervisningserfarenhet inom programmering och databaser samt inom distribuerade system och cloud computing.
  
Dokumenterad förmåga att undervisa inom operativsystem.
  
Dokumenterad förmåga att undervisa inom kompilatorteknik.
  
Kunskaper inom parallell programmering.
  
Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling eller molntjänster i näringslivet.
  
Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kursutveckling inom datavetenskap.
  
Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
  
  

**Tjänstgöringsort:** Karlskrona.
  
**Tjänstgöringsomfattning:** 100%.
  
**Tillträde:** Enligt överenskommelse.
  
**Varaktighet:** Tillsvidare.
  
**Sista ansökningsdag:** 2026-11-01.
  
  

Du ansöker via vårt rekryteringssystem genom att klicka på knappen ”ansök” nedan. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter så ska du inte registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringssystem. Kontakta istället HR-partnern som står som kontaktperson i annonsen för mer information. Anvisningar till sökande finns på https://www.bth.se/om-bth/jobba-hos-oss/lediga-jobb. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett i enlighet med annonsen och anvisningarna. BTH välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi arbetar aktivt för att ta tillvara de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi har valt medier för denna rekrytering och undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare för rekryteringstjänster.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
Stockholm, Sweden
  
What makes Cognizant a unique place to work? The combination of rapid growth and an international and innovative environment! This is creating a lot of opportunities for people like YOU — people with an entrepreneurial spirit who want to make a difference in this world.
  
At Cognizant, together with your colleagues from all around the world, you will collaborate on creating solutions for the world's leading companies and help them become more flexible, more innovative and successful. And this is your chance to be part of the success story: we are looking for an Informatica Architect to join our team in Sweden.
  
About the team
  
Cognizant Sweden boasts a robust team of professionals spread across various cities. Our local team includes experts in AI, data analytics, cloud services, and software development, ensuring we provide top-notch, localized support to our clients. The team is led by a seasoned professional, who brings extensive experience in cloud, AI and analytics and building high performing teams. Learn how Cognizant helps clients lead with digital at www.cognizant.com or follow us Cognizant.
  
Cognizant collaborates with all major hyperscale’s and relevant software vendors in the data and AI space. This includes partnerships with industry leaders such as AWS, Microsoft, Google, Snowflake, and Databricks. Our comprehensive approach ensures that we leverage the best tools and technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient solutions. Additionally, we are supported locally by our dedicated Centres of Excellence, which operate both nearshore and offshore. These centres provide specialized expertise and resources, ensuring that we can meet the unique needs of our clients and drive innovation in AI and data cost effectively.
  
About the role
  
3+ years of hands-on experience working with requirements and design to deliver complex data solutions.
  
Preferably background from Banking, with understanding of bank data and data delivery in a regulated environment
  
Very good communication and presentation skills (both written and oral) with proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams and drive discussions with architects and engineers to jointly design solutions and solve problems
  
Has experience from working with data related topics such as data sourcing, transformation rules, data quality rules, data privacy considerations and data delivery agreements.
  
Can take on and independently drive their own subset of activities
  
Experience from testing and quality assuring data deliveries
  
Quick to grasp new concepts, fast learning curve will be needed
  
Structured work approach
  
Technical Proficiencies
  
**Languages:** SQL
  
**Tools & Platforms:** AbInitio metadata hub or other Data Catalogue tool
  
Experience from data warehousing or analytics tools is meriting
  
What you can expect
  
Become part of a ‘flag ship’ success story - We go through enormous growth!
  
Organization driven by technology – We have a tremendous technology backbone

title: Research Engineer – Satellite DSM Generation Platform
description:
### **Job description**


We are seeking a technical Research Engineer to contribute to a Proof-of-Concept project funded by Digital Futures and hosted at KTH Geoinformatics Division.


The project builds on research showing that LiDAR-quality Digital Surface Models (DSMs) can be generated from a single optical satellite image, using deep-learning model. The goal is to take this research from prototype to an on-demand DEM/DSM platform, tested with real stakeholder.


You will be the core engineering hire for the project, working directly with the Principal Investigator and a small team of researchers to turn a validated research method (TRL 6–7) into a working platform ready for first users.


The successful candidate will:

* Design and build the on-demand DSM/DEM processing platform, from ingestion of a single optical satellite image to delivery of a high-resolution DSM output
* Integrate and deploy the existing deep-learning DSM generation model into a production-ready pipeline
* Develop the infrastructure needed to serve first pilot areas selected by priject stakeholders
* Build demo/prototype tooling to showcase platform accuracy and usability to stakeholders
* Support data quality, benchmarking against reference sources (e.g. Copernicus DSM, LiDAR DSM), and documentation
* Collect and incorporate user feedback to refine the platform toward an MVP
* Work closely with the research team at KTH Geoinformatics

### **Qualifications**

**Requirements**

* A graduate degree or an advanced level (higher education) in the research subject or equivalent competence.
* Documented experience in programming (e.g., Python or similar)
* Experience building or deploying data pipelines, APIs, and cloud-based systems
* Interest or background in geospatial data, remote sensing, or Earth Observation
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of engineering deliverables
* Good communication skills in English, as this will be required in day-to-day work

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with deep learning frameworks and deploying ML models in production
* Familiarity with cloud environments and containerized applications
* Experience handling large and heterogeneous geospatial datasets (satellite imagery, DEMs/DSMs)
* Background in Photogrammetry, Computer Vision, or Geoinformatics
* Experience with ESA data and cloud infrastructure
* Awareness of diversity and equal opportunity issues, with specific focus on gender equality


Great emphasis will be placed on personal skills.

title: Thesis Work - Integration of Data Centres into the Swedish Electricity System
description:
**Company Description**  

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company serving approximately 12 million customers and employing around 21,000 people. We believe there is a way to build a future where everyone can choose fossil-free ways to move, make, and live.

 **Job Description** *Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.*


Vattenfall R&D is responsible for conducting business driven technical development that creates value for the company and helps us realise our strategy. We develop cost-effective, safe and sustainable solutions to improve the infrastructure of Vattenfall assets including but not limited to Hydro, Wind, Nuclear, SKB, Heat, and Distribution.


The rapid development of artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and digital services is increasing both the number and capacity of data centres. These facilities may become significant electricity consumers with load characteristics that differ from conventional industrial demand due to power-electronic equipment, rapid workload variations, cooling systems, uninterruptible power supplies, and energy storage.


This thesis will investigate the integration of data centres into the Swedish electricity system. The initial phase will review available public and industrial data, data-centre electrical architectures, load profiles, modelling methods, and relevant flexibility opportunities. Based on the findings and data availability, the study will define and investigate one or more representative use cases.

**Potential research directions include:**

* Characterization and modelling of data-centre electricity demand
* Interaction between data centres and the electricity grid
* Assessment of available workload, power, and facility-level datasets
* Evaluation of data-centre flexibility through workload management or energy storage
* Participation in electricity, congestion-management, or flexibility markets
* Development of Python-based models or simulations in energy modelling software

**The goals and purpose of this thesis work are:**

* Literature and technology review
* Assessment of public and potentially available industrial datasets
* Definition of representative data-centre use cases
* Development of an appropriate modelling or optimisation framework
* Scenario and sensitivity analysis
* Evaluation of limitations, uncertainties, and future data requirements


This assignment is for 1 student.

 **Qualifications**  

We are looking for a student who is about to complete their academic studies and is eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety.

**Principal** **Expert** **Cloud Operations**

  

We are looking for a new member to join our highly skilled team to take the role of senior contributor and tech lead.

  

Our team develops, operates and monitors a system where Kubernetes is used to maintain a large fleet of pods running Schneider Electric proprietary software. The team also supports the Support organization by providing monitoring dashboards and actionable alerts, ensuring incidents are always discovered internally first. The system our team creates is managed by a Web Portal, also created by us as is the communication between the components.

* Deep understanding of networking and routing. Experience working with, and troubleshooting, in complex network architectures.

**Team Manager - Building Management Systems (BMS)**

 **What We Are Looking For**


We are currently seeking a highly motivated and inspiring **Team Manager** to lead the development of Schneider Electric's corporate **Building Management System (BMS) platform**.


As part of our global R&D organization, you will work closely with Product Management and development teams across multiple locations to drive innovation and deliver next-generation digital building solutions. Our state-of-the-art platform provides the foundational technology that enables customers to optimize building performance, sustainability, and operational efficiency.


This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership, technical strategy, and product development within one of Schneider Electric's most important digital offerings. It’s an ideal role for an experienced engineering leader who is ready to take on greater organizational impact and position themselves for future senior leadership opportunities.

 **Your Impact**


As Team Manager, you will lead a team responsible for developing software solutions that power the next generation of our BMS platform. You will create an environment where innovation, collaboration, execution and excellence thrive while ensuring the successful delivery of strategic objectives and product roadmaps.


Beyond leading day-to-day operations, you will help shape our engineering organization, influence strategic decisions, and contribute to the long-term development of our people, processes, and technology roadmap.


This position offers a unique opportunity for an ambitious leader who is motivated to broaden their impact, grow their organizational influence, and develop broader leadership responsibilities in the future.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a high-performing software development team within an agile environment.
* Coach, mentor, and support engineers in their professional growth and career development.
* Drive execution and delivery of product roadmaps while ensuring quality, efficiency, and predictability.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Architects, and Engineering teams across a global organization.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships and facilitate effective communication between teams and stakeholders.
* Foster a customer-centric culture focused on continuous improvement and innovation.
* Promote best practices in software development, including quality assurance, cybersecurity, maintainability, and sustainability.
* Drive the adoption of modern development approaches, tools, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
* Support strategic planning, resource management, and decision-making within the organization.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and execution excellence.

 **Required Skills and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience leading software development teams.
* At least 5 years of experience with direct reports.
* + Conduct development and performance reviews.
	+ Set goals and follow up on results.
	+ Provide feedback and coaching.
	+ Manage salary review and compensation processes.
	+ Support employee development and career planning.
* Proven track record of building, developing, and motivating high-performing engineering teams.
* Experience delivering complex software products in an agile environment.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

This is an exciting opportunity to join Schneider Electric and accelerate your career as a global technology leader.


At Schneider Electric, you'll be part of an international, innovative, and purpose-driven company where sustainability and digital transformation are at the core of everything we do. We invest in our people and empower them to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact every day.


In addition to leading a highly skilled engineering team, this role offers significant opportunities for professional development. As our organization continues to evolve, you will have the chance to expand your leadership scope, increase your strategic influence, and contribute to shaping the future direction of our software organization. This role is particularly well suited for a leader who is eager to continue growing and preparing for broader leadership responsibilities over time.


Join us and help shape the future of smart and sustainable buildings.

 **About Our Team**


The Building Management Systems (BMS) team is a cross-functional organization within Schneider Electric's Buildings business, based in Lund, Sweden.


We develop complete end-to-end solutions, from IoT sensors and controllers to cloud-connected services and modern web applications. Our mission is to help customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings.


We are proud of what we have built, but we are equally passionate about continuous improvement. We constantly explore new technologies, refine our development practices, and encourage learning across the entire team.


Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, ownership, and a shared drive to make both our products and ourselves better every day.

 **What We Do**


Our digital building management solutions help customers reduce energy consumption, lower operational costs, improve occupant comfort, and minimize environmental impact.


The BMS platform is a key pillar of Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure™ offering, enabling customers around the world to accelerate their digital and sustainability journeys.

title: Account Executive
description:
**Ongoing is continuing its journey of profitable growth and is now searching for Account Executives.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Ongoing is entering a new phase in how we work with customer acquisition**.** We are now looking for **Account Executives** to help us reach more logistics-intensive companies with Ongoing WMS and contribute to shaping how we position, sell and grow in the years ahead.

*Linda (CFO), Jakob (Sales Engineer), Karl (Head of Sales), and Ellinor (Head of Talent) discussing growth, customer needs, and how to continue building Ongoing's sales organisation.*

**About Ongoing**
-----------------


Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Gothenburg, Sweden, Ongoing is a leading cloud-native WMS for logistics-intensive companies, including both third-party logistics (‘3PL’) providers as well as businesses that operate their own warehouses.Designed for organisations with growing or established warehouse operations with demanding logistics requirements, the platform delivers real-time inventory control, goods management, customer communication and advanced analytics that reduce manual work and errors. With its user-friendly interface and scalable platform, Ongoing enables organisations to improve efficiency, enhance order accuracy, and gain full visibility across their supply chain, empowering them to adapt quickly in an increasingly fast-paced market.


Since July 2026, Ongoing has been a portfolio company of Cinven, a leading pan-European private-equity firm. This represents a new phase for the company, with strong ambitions to continue expanding internationally, strengthen how we approach new markets and customer segments, and develop more structured and scalable ways of identifying, reaching and acquiring new customers.

*Our office is located directly next to the Chalmers University campus in Johanneberg.*

**About the position**
----------------------


As an Account Executive at Ongoing, you will work with B2B sales toward companies where logistics and warehouse operations are central to the business. You will own and drive the commercial dialogue, while working closely with a Solution Architect who brings deep expertise in software development, Ongoing WMS and warehouse flows. Together, you will understand the customer’s operations, identify relevant needs, and show how Ongoing WMS can create value.

### ***In this role, you will***

* Drive B2B sales processes from first contact to signed agreement, with a consultative and long-term approach.
* Build relationships with prospective customers and manage opportunities throughout the sales cycle, from initial enquiry to signed agreement. All opportunities currently originate from inbound channels. As we to scale our sales organisation, the role will gradually involve a greater degree of proactive prospecting and business development.
* Understand customer needs, challenges, and logistics flows, and translate them into clear value-based discussions about Ongoing WMS.
* Contribute to the development of Ongoing’s sales strategy, including how we approach different customer segments, markets, and buying situations.
* Work closely with a Solution Architect throughout the sales process to combine commercial understanding with technical and operational expertise.
* Help Ongoing identify and develop new commercial opportunities across relevant customer segments and markets.

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


We are looking for someone with a solid understanding of logistics and proven experience in B2B sales. You should be able to understand complex customer operations, ask relevant questions, and build trust in discussions with decision-makers. This is a role for someone who can drive sales independently while collaborating closely with colleagues who bring deep product and technical expertise.

*Great sales results come from teamwork. Ellinor (Head of Talent) and Tobias (Customer Acquisition Engineer) collaborating to support growth, engage prospective customers, and strengthen Ongoing's commercial team.*

#### ***Required qualifications***

* At least 2-3 years of B2B sales experience within logistics, supply chain, warehousing, transport, 3PL, or a related industry. This includes responsibility for customer dialogues, needs analysis and closing new business.
* Ability to understand and discuss logistics and supply chain operations, particularly warehouse-related processes such as order fulfilment and inventory management.
* A consultative, structured, and proactive sales approach, with the ability to build long-term relationships and communicate value clearly.
* Professional proficiency in English is required. In addition, you need professional proficiency in Swedish, another Nordic language, or German.

#### ***Strong merits***

* Experience selling complex solutions with longer sales cycles or multiple stakeholders involved in the buying process.
* Experience in SaaS sales, preferably involving business-critical or operational software.
* Experience selling WMS, ERP, transport management systems or other logistics-related software solutions.
* Experience selling to logistics-intensive companies, 3PL providers or companies with warehouse operations.
* Experience with warehouse automation.
* Experience working with integrations between business-critical systems, such as WMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, transport management systems or similar solutions.

**Why join Ongoing?**
---------------------


Ongoing has grown by combining deep product knowledge, close customer relationships and a strong understanding of logistics-intensive businesses. As we continue to grow, we want to further strengthen how we work with sales strategically. In this role, you will help us identify the right customers, sharpen how we explain our value, and build more scalable ways of reaching new markets.


You will join a profitable, fast-growing tech company with a strong product, close customer relationships and deep logistics expertise. You will work closely with the people who build and implement Ongoing WMS, giving you direct access to product knowledge and support in the sales process.


This is a role with real ownership and visibility. You will help shape how Ongoing reaches new customers and markets, while working closely with knowledgeable colleagues across sales, product, implementation and software development. For someone who wants to combine B2B sales, SaaS and logistics in a growing international company, this is an opportunity to have a direct impact on the next phase of Ongoing’s growth.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
### ***Shape the technical direction at Lendo – and help build the future of our Product & Tech organization.***


Do you want to influence both technology and how engineering works across an entire organization? As Staff Engineer at Lendo, you will play a key role in shaping our technical direction, architecture and engineering practices across Product & Tech.  

  

Lendo is a successful fintech company with a strong financial position, ambitious plans and a modern Product & Tech organization. We are continuously developing our offering and exploring new products, technologies and ways of creating value for our customers. You will work from our modern office in central Stockholm, where collaboration, great coffee, snacks and a social environment are part of everyday life.

**The Opportunity**

* You get the opportunity to influence both technology and the wider Product & Tech organization.
* You will work directly with senior stakeholders and be part of the Product & Tech leadership team.
* Lendo combines a modern technical environment with an ambitious product and technology roadmap.
* Your impact will go beyond writing code – you will help shape architecture, technical standards, engineering capabilities and ways of working.
* You will join Lendo at an exciting time, with new products and exciting product initiatives ahead.

  

As Staff Engineer, you will be part of the Product & Tech leadership team, working closely with Engineering Managers, the Head of Technology and other key stakeholders to shape the technical direction across Product & Tech. You will act as a technical compass across our engineering organization, helping teams make sound technical decisions while staying close enough to the engineering work to understand and solve complex challenges.

**You will:**

* Own and evolve Lendo´s technical strategy, architecture and engineering standards.
* Set technical direction across multiple agile teams and create alignment around architecture and ways of working.
* Facilitate our Tech Lead forum and drive cross-team technical initiatives.
* Work with Product from an early stage to turn business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* Stay hands-on when needed through coding, prototyping and technical problem-solving.
* Mentor engineers and act as a technical sounding board across backend and frontend.
* Participate in technical skills assessments of engineers, helping ensure a consistent and high technical standard across the organization.
* Support teams in areas such as resilience, security, operational risk and major technical incidents.
* Work closely with our Data/ML team and explore how AI and modern technologies can create business value.

**The Team and Workplace**


The environment is modern, product-driven and forward-looking, with several new products and initiatives on the roadmap. This means you get the opportunity to influence areas that are still evolving, rather than simply stepping into an already established structure.


The role sits close to the wider Product & Tech leadership, rather than being limited to one individual development team. You will work closely with senior stakeholders and have the opportunity to influence decisions across the broader technology organization.

**About You**


We are looking for a senior engineer with a strong architectural mindset who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing others through technical expertise rather than formal authority.

**You have:**

* Extensive experience in software engineering, architecture or a similar senior technical role.
* Strong knowledge of modern software architecture and experience working across multiple teams.
* Experience with cloud environments, ideally GCP, and technologies such as Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Experience with or a strong understanding of Golang, TypeScript and/or React.
* The ability to move comfortably between strategic technical discussions and hands-on engineering.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to turn complex technical topics into clear decisions and actions.
* A pragmatic approach to balancing technical quality, business value and speed.
* A genuine interest in AI and modern technology.


Experience from a regulated or high-trust environment and/or working closely with Data/ML teams is a plus.


Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative and pragmatic. You take ownership, challenge existing solutions when needed and enjoy helping both people and technology move forward.

*In this recruitment process, we are collaborating with Ada Digital. Therefore, all applications should be submitted via Ada Digital's website. You can easily apply using the button below.*

title: Principal Engineer
description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique portfolios trading energy on the market.
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?
 



  





**Job Mission 🚀** 




 As our
 **Principal Engineer** 
 , you'll report to our VP of Engineering and join our engineering org of ~80 people. You will serve as the technical authority driving the overarching architecture and engineering strategy across all of Tibber. You will bridge complex domain problems, from distributed real-time IoT pipelines to energy market integration, with resilient, high-scale software systems. Your work directly enables millions of smart devices to balance power grids across Europe, unlocking new horizons in sustainable energy consumption.
 



  





**What You'll Do ✅** 



* You will own the overall architecture and technical strategy for low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems capable of coordinating millions of connected smart devices in real time, working in close collaboration with senior staff and staff engineers to design and evolve these systems.



  




* You will set technical vision, standards, and best practices across domain teams, partnering with senior staff and staff engineers to drive engineering excellence and operational resilience.



  




* You will partner closely with product leaders and executive stakeholders to align long-term technical roadmaps with business objectives.



  




* You will evaluate emerging technologies, prototype novel concepts, and guide strategic tech-stack decisions to keep Tibber ahead of market shifts.



  




* You will mentor and empower senior engineering talent, elevating technical craft, architecture design capabilities, and problem-solving skills throughout the company.



  




* You will diagnose and solve systemic, high-impact architectural bottlenecks, ensuring seamless integration across energy trading, IoT, and user-facing platforms.



  




* You will champion platform reliability, security, and developer efficiency, removing technical friction for autonomous engineering teams.



  





**What We're Looking For⚡** 




 You are motivated by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:
 


* Have demonstrable experience as a Principal, Staff, or Chief Engineer designing and operating mission-critical distributed systems at scale.



  




* Possess deep expertise in modern cloud architectures, event-driven microservices, high-throughput IoT streaming pipelines, or energy tech infrastructures.



  




* Demonstrate strong technical leadership and communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment on high-stakes architecture decisions.



  




* Combine long-term strategic vision with a hands-on pragmatic approach, willing to dive into code or debug complex incidents when required.



  




* Are passionate about green technology, sustainable energy transition, and creating products that make a tangible environmental impact.



  




* You will set the bar for how we build with AI agents, and shape how the rest of engineering adopts new AI-driven ways of working



  





**The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️** 




 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.
 



 We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!
 



  





 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.
 



  





 You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Stockholm, EU only)
description:
Anyfin is building the next generation of consumer finance. We’re profitable, scaling quickly, and now operating with a banking license which opens up a lot of technical complexity.
   

  

 We’re looking for a senior fullstack engineer who enjoys moving fast, taking real ownership, and building things that actually have an impact.
   

  

 If that sounds like your kind of environment, keep reading. Because honestly, it’s not a role for everyone.
   

  

**Small team, high responsibility**
 We hire carefully. We’re not a company that grows by adding headcount everywhere, we grow by keeping the bar high and building a team where every person matters.
   

  

 This isn’t a place where you disappear into a big org. If you join, you’ll have real influence on what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 You’ll work across the stack, end to end:
   

  

* Build and ship features across backend, web and mobile.
* Own projects from idea to production (and beyond).
* Make product and technical decisions, not just implement tasks.
* Build systems that scale with real users and real money.
* Work closely with product and design, in person, every week.


 Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, React, React Native.
   

  

**How We Think About Building**
 We’re pragmatic. We like speed, but we also care about building things that last.
   

  

 AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s embedded in how we work helping engineers move faster, reduce friction and focus on solving meaningful problems.
   

  

 We’re looking for engineers who are curious about that shift and want to be part of it, rather than people who feel like good engineering means doing everything the hard way.
   

  

 No ego. Just good judgment and high output.
   

  

**You’ll thrive here if you…**
* Have solid fullstack experience.
* Take responsibility naturally and don’t wait to be told what to do.
* Enjoy messy problems and figuring things out as you go.
* Like being in an ambitious and collaborative team.
* Want to build, not just maintain.


**You’re Comfortable With Things Like**
* Backend microservice architecture and API design.
* React-based frontend work.
* Databases, CI/CD, cloud (GCP).
* Shipping real products to real users.


**A few practical notes**
* Stockholm based.
* EU work authorization required.


**Why Anyfin?**
 Because this is one of those moments where a company is about to level up: Banking license secured, expansion ahead and a lot to build.
   

  

 If you want to be part of a small, high-trust team doing meaningful work, we’d love to hear from you. Apply only if you want the responsibility that comes with real impact.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.
