title: Product Engineer, Growth Acquisition
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 The web is changing.
   

  

 For twenty years, websites have been built around content management systems, where people manually create, edit, and publish every page. We think that era is ending. AI is changing how digital experiences are designed, built, optimized, and discovered, and websites are becoming composable systems built on structured content, reusable components, data, and AI.
   

  

 We’ve already started building that at Mentimeter, moving to a Markdown-based system with a bespoke CMS and agentic workflows. Now we’re looking for an engineer who’ll help us take it to the next level.
   

  

 Our website is our storefront. It’s where millions of people meet Mentimeter for the first time, and it sits in the middle of almost everything we do: product, marketing, sales, brand, search. Your job is to own the technical foundation underneath it and keep making it better at one thing: helping people find Mentimeter, understand it, and sign up.
   

  

 In practice, that means evolving the Growth Operating System—the platform that lets engineers, designers, marketers, copywriters, and AI agents work on world-class digital experiences together. This isn’t a job maintaining a marketing website. It’s building the machine that produces one.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 You'll own the technical foundation behind web acquisition, and not only the building of it. You'll help decide what's worth building, ship it, measure it, and interpret what the results actually mean.
   

  

**Web platform**
 Frontend architecture, the component library, deployment pipeline, performance, and the foundations everything else sits on.
   

  

**Growth Operating System**
 The systems, workflows, and automation that let people and AI work together across the whole web lifecycle. Design systems, structured content, experimentation, analytics, and AI, connected into something coherent instead of a CMS with bolted-on features.
   

  

**Discoverability**
 Technical SEO, structured data, AI search, and whatever comes next for being found, both by search engines and by AI assistants.
   

  

**Measurement and attribution**
 Analytics, event instrumentation, server-side tracking, Conversion APIs, attribution and marketing measurement. If we can't trust the numbers, we can't learn anything from them.
   

  

**Experimentation**
 The infrastructure behind fast experiments, personalization, feature flags and continuous optimization, and making that infrastructure usable by people who don't write code.
   

  

**Internal platform**
 Tooling, automation and AI-assisted workflows that make life easier for marketers, designers, copywriters, editors and localization teams.
   

  

**Design system**
 Working with Design on a component system that scales, stays consistent and accessible, and doesn't slow anyone down.
   

  

**AI enablement**
 The knowledge and context layer that gives AI agents what they need to generate, improve, and localize content well. That includes turning product analytics, marketing data, and experiment results into context a model can actually use, and having the judgment to know when the output is good enough to ship.
   

  

**How You'll Work**
 We call this a Product Engineer role, and we mean something specific by it.
   

  

**Start with the outcome**
 You'll work with our Growth PM, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to clarify the problem we're solving and how we'll know it worked before much gets built. If a brief doesn't hold up, we expect you to say so, and to bring your own ideas about where the leverage is.
   

  

**Finish the loop**
 Get clear on the outcome, ship, watch what happens, learn, adjust. Shipping is the middle of the job, not the end. The experiment that failed is often more interesting than the one that worked, as long as somebody bothers to find out why.
   

  

**Be Clear About Trade-offs**
 A growth team moves fast, and a lot of what we build is meant to be thrown away. Knowing which parts aren't is the real craft. We'd rather you weigh speed against quality, scale, and risk out loud, with reasons, than default to one end of it.
   

  

**Keep the standard where it counts**
 Testing, observability and sensible security defaults aren't the opposite of speed on a surface this exposed. They're what makes speed survivable. When you ship something, you check that it works for real people in production.
   

  

**Use AI properly**
 AI-native development is how this team works, and we want someone fluent in it who'll keep pushing the rest of us. You're still on the hook for what ships. Read it, test it, understand it, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft.
   

  

**Build For The People Who Use What You Build**
 Your users aren't only visitors to the site. They're marketers, copywriters, designers, localization teams, and other engineers. The questions worth asking include: how do we make publishing easier, automate the boring parts, improve the quality of what AI produces, take friction out of editing, and put experimentation in more hands? Good platforms disappear into the background. When this one works, everyone else gets faster.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 Not lines of code. Business results, and how quickly we learn.
   

  

* More visitors turning into signups
* Faster experimentation
* Better discoverability across search engines and AI assistants
* A faster website
* Attribution we can trust
* Less manual work and quicker publishing
* A better experience for the engineers and editors who use the platform
* More leverage from automation and AI


**Who You Are**
 You live and breathe the web. You find it interesting how modern sites get built, found, measured and improved, and you like understanding the whole stack, from browser rendering and frontend architecture through to search engines, analytics, AI and experimentation. You care about the systems behind the experience as much as the experience itself, and you think in platforms rather than projects.
   

  

 You're curious about users and customers, and comfortable having an opinion about what we should build, not only how to build it. The future of AI excites you, and so does the unglamorous engineering that makes AI useful in practice.
   

  

 You share what you know. You write things down, you give people context, and the people around you get better for working with you.
   

  

**You'll Probably Have Experience With**
* React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend engineering
* Technical SEO and modern search technologies
* AI search, structured content and discoverability
* Web analytics and event instrumentation
* Server-side tracking and Conversion APIs
* Marketing attribution and analytics
* Experimentation platforms and A/B testing
* Core Web Vitals and frontend performance
* APIs, integrations and automation
* Headless CMS platforms and component-driven architectures
* AI-assisted software development
* Modern deployment platforms such as Vercel
* Building internal tooling and developer platforms


 Nobody has all of this. Tell us which parts you'd be picking up along the way.
   

  

**How We Work, And Who This Suits**
 We're an outcome-oriented team. We work closely with Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Analytics to find opportunities, test ideas and build things that move the business. We'd rather be fast and learn than be perfect.
   

  

 Two honest things about the team, because they're the difference between enjoying this job and not.
   

  

 The website is everyone's front door, so plenty of work gets pushed at us from outside. There's more ad hoc work and more context switching here than on a core product team. Some engineers love that and some find it draining. Both are reasonable, and it's worth knowing which one you are before you apply.
   

  

 Some of the most valuable work also takes months to show up in a graph. SEO, measurement, platform foundations. You need to invest in what you believe in before the numbers move, and be honest enough to stop when the evidence says you got it wrong.
   

  

**Why you'll love this role**
 You'll help shape one of the world's leading product-led growth companies while it goes through a real transformation. Modern web technology, AI-native ways of working, and a small team that likes curiosity, experimentation, and good craft.
   

  

 And you'll build the operating system behind how millions of people discover Mentimeter.
   

  

**Compensation**
*At Mentimeter, we believe in fair and transparent compensation that grows with you. The salary range for this role is SEK 60,000–SEK 80,000 per month. It’s intentionally broad to reflect the different stages of growth within the role: from early development to deep expertise and meaningful impact.*
*Where an individual is placed within the range depends on factors such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, and alignment with the role’s requirements. We’re committed to supporting your growth. You’ll have ongoing development conversations with your manager, and your salary will evolve as you build skills and contribute to our mission.*
***In addition to your monthly salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package—learn more about it here:***
 https://www.mentimeter.com/benefits/stockholm
 ***.***
**What Mentimeter Can Offer**
 At Mentimeter we can offer a diverse and inclusive work environment supported by smart and driven colleagues. We believe in continuous professional development for all of our colleagues and therefore offer access to a leadership program (including external personal coach) and relevant education to ensure that we continue to be state-of-the-art when it comes to innovating and building Mentimeter. Your place will be in a growing company with lots of career opportunities, working on a beloved product used by more than 300 million people. It’s not all about work though, we also offer a very healthy view on work-life balance.
   

  

 All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package, including pension contributions. Learn more about our benefits by visiting our Benefits & Perks page
   

  

**AI and Hiring at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter, we believe AI helps us work smarter - but it never replaces the human assessment, curiosity, and personal connection that define our culture and our hiring. We use AI as a sparring partner: to bounce ideas, bring new perspectives, support structure, and make our work more efficient. But the meaning, decisions, and interactions always come from people.
   

  

* AI does not screen or decide on candidates.
* There is no automated filtering, ranking, or decision-making in our recruitment process. Every application is reviewed by a person.
* Hiring teams may use AI to support their work - for example, to structure notes, prepare interview questions, or organize their thinking.


 AI strengthens our work, but it does not define it. At Mentimeter, we’re not building an AI-driven hiring process - we’re building a people-first culture, where technology helps us listen, learn, and grow together.
   

  

**Culture at Mentimeter**
 At Mentimeter we believe in giving everyone a voice - regardless of who you are. So we build a platform that does just that. Our platform is not only our product but also our organization. A platform where people feel safe, where differences are embraced, a place where you can have fun. We strongly encourage applicants who are people of color, LGBTQ+, women, people with disabilities, and/or formerly incarcerated people, and a college degree is not strictly required. In order to give everyone a voice, we need to be as diverse as our users.
   

  

 Learn more about our culture by visiting our Culture page.
   

  

 Review our Privacy Policy for more information.

 DigitalTolk is an organization and company that works to make an impact. Our purpose is to give a voice to those who don’t speak the local language; we arrange translators so that patients can get medical treatments in their new country and communicate with doctors. We arrange translators for crime victims so that they can get justice. Our job is to arrange interpreters through our platform for our customers.

title: Engineering Director
description:
Mentimeter is an engagement tool with a clear goal in mind. To make every leader better. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable insights and impactful moments.
   

  

 We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together.
   

  

**Summer hiring notice:** 
 Due to summer vacations, we will begin the reviewing and interviewing process for this role from August. However, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 At Mentimeter, strategy turns into product in our Areas – groups of teams led by a Product Director, with you owning the engineering alongside them. You'll be one of two Engineering Directors at Mentimeter, sitting in Area Leadership: you own how we build – technical direction, architecture, quality, and engineering leadership – and co-own your Areas' outcomes and trade-offs with your Product Director and Design Director peers.
   

  

 In practice, that means leading 5–8 teams of typically 2–5 engineers each, through your Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers, building a product used by more than 300 million people. Your accountability is the performance of the Product Areas: clear team missions, strong engineering leadership, healthy delivery, and outcomes that ladder into company, technology, and product strategy.
   

  

 This is a senior, high-impact role in a company growing into a multi-product business at global scale.
   

  

 What this role is
   

  

**It is a technical leadership role.** 
 Together with your Staff Engineers – the bar-setters who lead the craft inside the teams – you own technical direction and architectural coherence across your Areas: the standards for how we build, and an engineering-quality bar that holds. You set and evolve that technical strategy with them; it does not arrive from somewhere else.
   

  

**It is also a business leadership role.** 
 You reason about customer outcomes, capacity, and investment, not just engineering. Build-vs-borrow-vs-buy calls land on your desk, and we expect you to ground them in a business context.
   

  

**It is a role where you lead through leaders.** 
 Your job is to grow Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers who grow great engineers. If your instinct is to be the smartest engineer in the room, this will frustrate you.
   

  

**It is not a delivery management role.** 
 Delivery belongs to the teams, not to you or your Engineering Managers, and we place heavy trust in them to run it. EMs grow engineers; you create the conditions: ownership so unambiguous that escalations are rare, and decision boundaries so clear that autonomy actually works.
   

  

**It is not a role where strategy is handed to you.** 
 You grab ambiguity unfazed and create clarity for others, in a company that keeps changing shape as it grows.
   

  

**It is not a hands-off role either.** 
 This is not a role for leaders who think of themselves as engineering adjacent. You stay close enough to the technology to challenge and be challenged.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Turn strategy into outcomes
   

  

* Translate company, technology, and product strategy into clear team missions, boundaries, and success measures.
* Keep technology and product strategy tightly aligned: shared priorities, shared trade-offs, shared outcomes.
* Own the Areas' outcomes together with your Product and Design peers, from planning through delivery.


 Own how we build
   

  

* Own technical direction and architectural coherence across your Areas – the systems hang together as teams move fast.
* Set the engineering-quality bar with your Staff Engineers: the standards for how we build and review, held consistently across teams.
* Move your Areas toward agentic development – make AI part of how every team builds, and own that shift as an outcome, not an experiment.


 Create the conditions for autonomous teams
   

  

* Give teams unambiguous ownership, a clear mission, and known decision boundaries. That is what autonomy is built on.
* Build a native product-engineering culture where engineers participate in discovery and work from customer and business outcomes.


 Allocate capacity and investments
   

  

* Allocate engineering capacity across teams, and rebalance as priorities change.
* Make trade-offs at Area level rather than inside individual teams, and decide where engineering effort creates the most value.
* Drive build-vs-borrow-vs-buy decisions with long-term business impact in mind. Budget, headcount, and tooling follow strategy.


 Lead the leaders
   

  

* Coach and grow your Engineering Managers and the Areas' Staff Engineers, and hold them accountable for the growth of their engineers and systems.
* Raise the leadership bar: calibrate how your leaders show up across their teams, and step in early when a team needs more.
* Build the next generation of engineering leadership through hiring, feedback, and honest development conversations.


 Keep delivery healthy
   

  

* Balance speed, quality, and technical investment so the Areas deliver without heroics.
* Resolve cross-team and cross-Area dependencies before they become bottlenecks.
* Spot weak signals in team delivery and technical direction, and course-correct early.
* Make technical debt visible and deliberately managed, not discovered in firefights.


 What success looks like
   

  

* Every team in your Areas can explain its mission, ownership, and success criteria – and has the autonomy to act on them.
* Engineering investments clearly ladder into product, technology, and company strategy.
* The architecture stays coherent as teams move fast, and the engineering-quality bar holds across your Areas.
* Your Areas are visibly further along on agentic development – AI is part of how every team builds, and you can show the shift.
* Product and Design pull engineering into decisions early – because they want to, not because they have to.
* Your Engineering Managers grow visibly, and engineers' craft grows because of them.
* The Areas deliver against their goals, and hold that pace under pressure.
* Issues surface early; late-stage reversals and escalations are rare.


 How you lead, and how AI runs through it
   

  

 You lead with heart and bravery: you care personally about people and decide courageously, in line with our leadership commitment. You balance care and challenge, supporting your leaders while holding a high bar. You multiply through others.
   

  

 And you are AI-native. Not as an initiative, but as an instinct. AI runs through how you work, how you think, and how you lead – and you are actively rethinking what an engineering organization looks like when AI is part of how every team builds. Pushing the craft forward is part of who you are: you want to be at the forefront of the move from a software development lifecycle to an agentic one – from SDLC to ADLC. We are working this out in practice at Mentimeter, and you will help set the patterns the rest of the company learns from.
   

  

 We believe you have
   

  

* You were an excellent engineer before you were a leader: deep fluency in code, systems, and your domain, now extended into how AI changes all three. That foundation carried you into leading teams, and then into leading the leaders of teams.
* Five or more years of engineering leadership at scale: you have led Engineering Managers and senior staff across an organization of 50+ engineers, with a track record of growing them and the business.
* Experience owning engineering across multiple teams in a product company, ideally at Area or department level.
* A habit of turning strategy into team scope, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience allocating capacity and making investment trade-offs across teams, not only within one.
* Strong product instincts: you work from user and business outcomes, not delivery tasks.
* A track record of owning technical direction and architecture across multiple teams, and keeping it coherent as they scale.
* Commercial judgment: you ground investment calls in business context.
* Experience leading through change: restructures, migrations, and ever-shifting priorities.


**It is beneficial if you have**
* Experience from product-led B2B SaaS.
* Hands-on experience leading teams through the shift to AI-driven engineering.
* Experience reshaping organizations as they change along with their needs.

title: Customer Success Manager - Sweden
description:
*Are you someone who enjoys guiding customers, solving complex challenges, and driving both operational and commercial results?*
*As a Customer Success Manager at Staria, you’ll take the lead for our ERP customers – ensuring seamless service delivery, strengthening collaboration, and unlocking new opportunities for growth. If you thrive on building strong customer partnerships and long-term value, this role offers an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact for our customers’ success.*
**What It’s All About**
 Staria’s ERP Continuous Services help growth‑driven companies keep their NetSuite environments running smoothly, efficiently, and in a way that supports their business goals. Our services cover everything from day‑to‑day operational support and ticket coordination to long‑term roadmap planning, development initiatives, and proactive value creation – all tailored to each customer’s evolving needs.
   

  

 Here, you’ll join a team of Customer Success Managers, working closely with our Head of Customer Success in the daily operations and with our Head of Continuous Services on more complex cases and development initiatives. Alongside key account executives, service delivery teams, project managers, and colleagues across different functions, you’ll help deliver seamless, high‑quality ERP services that drive customer satisfaction and long‑term growth.
   

  

**Journey that awaits you**
 As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll lead a portfolio of 20–25 ERP customers, ensuring service delivery stays on track, expectations are clear, and collaboration flows effortlessly. You’ll bring structure to complex setups, align stakeholders, and help customers get the full value out of their NetSuite investment.
   

  

 In this role, you will take ownership of the commercial development of your accounts, identifying upsell and cross‑sell opportunities, advising customers on new features, and strengthening the long‑term growth and profitability of your portfolio. Whether it’s coordinating delivery teams, managing escalations, or uncovering new ways to create value, you’ll be the strategic partner who keeps everything moving in the right direction.
   

  

 In addition to leading customer relationships and service delivery, you'll also work directly with customers in a hands-on advisory capacity, helping them develop their NetSuite environment. A significant part of the role involves delivering billable customer work, with approximately 50% of your time spent on advisory and development activities such as roadmap planning, issue resolution, and value‑adding analysis.
   

  

 Another exciting part of this role is the timing: you’d be joining just as our Continuous Services model is evolving. Instead of stepping into a rigid setup, you’ll join at a moment where ways of working, collaboration models, and customer success practices are actively being refined. You’ll therefore have the space and trust to influence and put your mark on how we operate and shape the customer journey.
   

  

 In practice you will:
   

  

* Ensure smooth and predictable service delivery: Confirming schedules, coordinating allocations, maintaining continuity of customer work, and setting clear expectations.
* Generate billable work: Identifying value‑adding tasks and maintaining a target billability level of approximately 50%.
* Coordinate and report on ticket SLAs: Monitoring progress and keeping customers informed.
* Lead customer cooperation: Strengthening communication, guiding collaboration, and ensuring customers get full value from NetSuite.
* Monitor NPS and feedback: Adjusting services based on insights.
* Drive ARR growth & profitability: Identifying upsell/cross‑sell opportunities and advising on new features.
* Own profitability management: Conducting customer profitability analyses, spotting risks, identifying potential profitability increase opportunities, preparing action plans.
* Coordinate internal delivery and development: Aligning internal competences with customer needs and ensuring progress on roadmap and development items.
* Oversee contracts: Keeping systems updated and informing service teams of changes.
* Manage escalations: Resolving issues quickly and involving the right experts.


**The practical stuff**
 We are seeking candidates based in Stockholm area. Staria’s hybrid work model offers the best of both worlds: modern offices, combined with the flexibility to work remotely. To ensure smooth collaboration with your team and stakeholders, we hope you’re able to spend a few days per week at the office on average.
   

  

 Our base salary range for this role is 50 500- 61 000kr/month, depending on your background and scope of the role.
   

  

**Keys to success in this role**
 To thrive in this role, we believe that you have a background in ERP or business systems and extensive experience in customer‑facing roles – like for example, Customer Success, Key Account Management, or Account Executive positions. The role can also fit those coming from an ERP consulting background and who now want to work more commercially and build long‑term customer relationships.
   

  

 A significant part of the role involves working in a billable setup, where your time, expertise and work are billed to the customer. Previous experience with billable work is an advantage, but not a requirement, as long as you’re comfortable stepping into a role where your contribution is part of the customer‑facing service.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you need:
   

  

* Strong operational leadership – the ability to structure complex customer setups, manage schedules, and keep delivery teams aligned.
* Proven experience managing customer relationships – building trust, handling difficult conversations, and guiding customers through decisions and prioritization.
* Ability to work in a billable setup – either previous experience or comfort working in a model where your time and expertise are billed to the customer.
* Commercial skills – understanding profitability, spotting upsell/cross‑sell opportunities, and advising customers on features that create value.
* Stakeholder management – coordinating multiple teams, involving the right experts, and ensuring everyone works toward the same goal.
* Analytical capability – interpreting customer data, identifying risks, and preparing clear action plans for profitability and cooperation.
* Problem‑solving – handling escalations, resolving blockers, and driving issues to completion with confidence.
* Adaptability in changing environments – adjusting quickly when priorities shift and staying calm when customer needs evolve.
* Continuous improvement mindset – proactively improving ways of working, both internally and with customers, and contributing to the development of our Continuous Services model.
* English and Swedish skills – written and verbal skills in both languages are required for the role.


**Why join us**
* Here, growth isn’t just a buzzword. You’ll get real opportunities to develop your skills, take ownership, and leave your mark on how we work. You’ll have the freedom to shape your role, drive change, and influence the way we do things. We trust you to know what works.
* We are serious about growth, but never too serious at work. Our hierarchy is low and the atmosphere is relaxed. Here, you can bring your whole self to work — personality, quirks, and all.
* Flexibility is part of our DNA. In our hybrid model you can work from home, our office in Stockholm or even abroad from time to time. We care about results, not where you sit.
* While we value flexible remote work, we also prioritize in-person connections: onboarding and team days, office breakfasts, and shared events bring us together on a regular basis.
* We’re proud of our Great Workplace certification, because it’s based on what matters most: strong teamwork, sense of purpose, managers who truly listen, and a culture where people want to stick around.
* We’re truly international, with customers and colleagues across borders. You’ll get to collaborate with experts from different countries and backgrounds.
* We’re growing and our finances are solid. You can focus on your work without worrying about the ground shifting under your feet.
* You’ll get benefits that make everyday life smoother: flex time, 30 vacation days, half days before public holidays, and generous recreational perks are all part of the deal.


**Got interested?**
 Apply easily with your resume and by answering a few short questions as soon as possible, by
 **18th of October, 2026** 
 at the latest. No cover letter needed. We review applications throughout the application period and are ready to move quickly if we find the right candidate.
   

  

 If you have any questions about the position, our ERP Manager, Martin, would be happy to provide more information. You can reach Martin at 0729375729 on 1 Oct. at 9-9.30,2 Oct. 14.00-14.30 and 6 Oct. at 9.00-9.30 (CET).
   

  

 For questions related to our recruitment process, please send an email to recruitment@staria.com. Please note that for data protection reasons, we only accept applications submitted through our recruitment system.
   

  

 At Staria, we believe that everyone brings something unique to the table. We appreciate diversity and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee feels valued. We warmly invite candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply and join our team. We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

**Wondering what happens after you apply?** 
 Check out our recruitment journey here!
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

*Staria empowers growth companies with Global Accounting Services, ERP Consulting, and BI & Planning Solutions. We are dedicated to supporting our customers' growth through our expert advisory services and tailored solutions. As the only company in Europe capable of delivering financial services and solutions to over 50 countries with a single dedicated team, we pride ourselves on our unique position in the market. With a team of over 550 professionals spanning 7 countries, we embody Staria's values of Collaboration, Courage & Commitment. Join us in shaping the future of finance for growth companies.*

title: Account Executive - Norway
description:
The
 **Account Executive** 
 is responsible for obtaining new business and customer expansion sales opportunities from Executive-level buyers and influencers in either private or publicly traded companies. Account Executives are focused on selling Workiva’s core platform and collaborate with other Workiva Solution Sales teams to deliver multi-solution sales.
   

  

 Successful candidates will build relationships and identify Workiva products and solutions that meet customer needs to drive customer acquisition. Sales growth is attained through new customer subscriptions, professional services, delivery and training.
   

  

 This role will be focussing specifically on Norway as part of our broader Nordics sales team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Actively seek out sales opportunities in collaboration with peer Sales teams, Inside Sales, and Partnerships to generate qualified sales pipeline
* Utilize information gathered during the needs analysis phase to deliver a compelling demonstration of the Workiva platform
* Skillfully address customer objections - removing obstacles - and finding solutions to various client challenges
* Lead the sales process naturally - guiding it to a close by effectively showcasing Workiva's value proposition
* Regularly and promptly update customer relationship management tools to report customer contacts
* Provide consistent and accurate forward-looking information through pipeline analysis to forecast sales
* Develop and execute a sales strategy with purposeful action to secure the sale
* Rally internal support to pursue an account and optimize internal resources
* Prioritize selling activities and ensure timely follow-through
* Maintain a strong understanding of Workiva products through a commitment to ongoing training and a growth mindset


**What You'll Need**
 Minimum Qualifications
   

  

* 4+ years experience in a related role - enterprise technology or similar complex solution sales
* Undergraduate Degree or equivalent combination of knowledge and related career experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of the Software as a Service (SaaS) business model
* Ability to demonstrate complex software applications
* Strong business acumen and an ability to understand complex business challenges
* Executive presence and an ability to communicate at the most senior level
* Ability to identify and understand the power of influencers versus buyers and how to navigate the nuances of each during the sales cycle
* Ability to manage multiple complex sales cycles simultaneously
* Ability to negotiate pricing with a focus on retaining value
* Capability for achieving (and exceeding) sales quota targets
* Fluency in Norwegian preferred


**Travel Requirement & Working Conditions**
* Up to 30% travel for regular customer meetings and events
* Reliable internet access required for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office


**Why Join Workiva**
 Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. title: Senior Manager / Director to Operations – Management Consulting

 Your work may include designing operating models, optimizing global footprints, implementing new processes, improving cost efficiency and driving large-scale business transformation.  As a Senior Manager or Director, you will report directly to the Head of Customer & Operations and become an integral part of the Customer & Operations leadership team. You will play a key role in shaping the strategic direction, growth agenda and market positioning of the practice.
   

  

 Beyond client delivery, you will contribute to KPMG’s continued growth by identifying and developing new business opportunities, owning the commercial and contractual aspects of client engagements from opportunity development through negotiation and deal closure, and building long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders.
   

  

 You will also coach and mentor consultants, provide constructive feedback, support their professional development and help build high-performing teams. In addition, you will contribute to the development of our methods, offerings and go-to-market initiatives.
   

  

 The role can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg or Malmö, depending on your location and preference.
   

  

 ,
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We believe that you:
   

  

* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering or a related field
* Have 8-12+ years of experience from a top tier management consultancy
* Have led strategy, transformation and/or performance improvement projects within supply chain or operations, such as manufacturing, network optimization, warehousing, logistics, planning, procurement or similar areas
* Are comfortable engaging and influencing senior executives and key decision-makers
* Have strong leadership skills and a passion for coaching, mentoring and developing people
* Have a proven ability to generate business, build client relationships and own commercial outcomes
* Are fluent in English and preferably also in Swedish
* Experience working with operational systems and platforms (e.g. ERP, forecasting & planning, procurement and logistics tools) is considered a strong advantage


**What We Offer**
 We believe in creating the right conditions for our people to grow. At KPMG Management Consulting, you will work in a dynamic environment where client impact, professional development and collaboration go hand in hand. You will help drive change across industries and contribute to a rapidly growing business.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing practice and accelerate your career while shaping the future of operations for leading organisations.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* A high-impact leadership role in a fast-growing consulting team
* The opportunity to contribute to the development of our methods, offerings and go-to-market initiatives
* A collaborative and ambitious culture with highly skilled colleagues
* A flexible work environment with a strong focus on personal and professional growth

Hos oss utvecklas du i en kultur där din röst alltid blir hörd. Och allt vi får över ger vi tillbaka till samhället. Det är så vi gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Om Apoteket E-handel & Online Product and Development
   

  

 E-handeln är en central del av Apotekets tillväxt, där vår ambition är att möta kundernas behov i en allt mer digital vardag. Här utvecklar vi våra digitala kanaler – app och webb – för att skapa en sömlös, engagerande och relevant kundupplevelse.
   

  

 Inom Online Product & Development utvecklar och optimerar vi Apotekets digitala produkter, tjänster och kundupplevelser. Vårt arbete ska skapa ökad kundnytta, försäljning och lönsamhet samt bidra till Apotekets fortsatta digitala utveckling.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett nära och samarbetsinriktat team med kompetens inom bland annat produktledning, UX, experimentering och growth. Tillsammans arbetar vi med utvecklingen av Apotekets e-handel och skapar en tydlig brygga mellan verksamheten och Tech.
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 I rollen som Product Manager Online ansvarar du för att utveckla och optimera digitala produkter, tjänster och kundupplevelser inom Apotekets e-handel. Du omsätter affärsbehov, kundinsikter och tekniska möjligheter till prioriterade initiativ som stärker kundupplevelsen och affären.
   

  

 Ditt huvudsakliga ansvarsområde omfattar app, omnikanal, personalisering, kunddata samt betalplattformar och betallösningar. Du bidrar till produktvision, strategi, roadmap och målbild och leder arbetet från identifierat behov till genomförd och uppföljd lösning.
   

  

 Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och ett nära samarbete med bland annat andra produktledare, produktägare, affärsrepresentanter, UX, utvecklare, analytiker, marknad och externa systemleverantörer. Du behöver kunna balansera olika verksamhetsbehov mot tekniska förutsättningar och tillgänglig leveranskapacitet, samtidigt som du håller riktningen framåt.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad på vårt huvudkontor i Solna, Stockholm, med en förväntan att vara på kontoret cirka tre dagar i veckan.
   

  

 Vad du kommer göra hos oss:
   

  

 Som Product Manager Online har du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra utvecklingsresurser fokuseras på de initiativ som ger störst kund- och affärsvärde. Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Samla in och analysera behov från kunder, verksamheten och andra intressenter.
* Arbeta datadrivet med uppföljning av kundbeteenden, konvertering, försäljning och kundupplevelse.
* Identifiera förbättringsområden i den digitala kundresan och omsätta insikter till krav, epics och utvecklingsinitiativ.
* Prioritera utvecklingsinsatser utifrån kundvärde, affärsnytta, strategiska mål och tekniska förutsättningar.
* Bidra till och strukturera produktvision, produktstrategi, roadmap och målbild.
* Leda och koordinera arbetet mellan verksamheten, UX, utvecklingsteam, analytiker och externa leverantörer.
* Följa upp levererade funktioner och säkerställa att de skapar avsedd effekt.
* Bidra till stabila, skalbara och framtidssäkra digitala lösningar.


**Vem söker vi?**
 Vi söker dig som har senior erfarenhet av Product Management inom e-handel och som trivs i gränslandet mellan affär, teknik och kundupplevelse. Du har arbetat med digital produktutveckling för webb och app och är van att samarbeta med agila utvecklingsteam.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* Akademisk utbildning på kandidat- eller masternivå.
* Senior erfarenhet av Product Management inom e-handel.
* Erfarenhet av produktutveckling för webb och app.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med agila utvecklingsteam.
* Erfarenhet av datadrivet arbete, analys och uppföljning av digitala kundbeteenden.
* Erfarenhet av att prioritera mellan affärsnytta, kundvärde och tekniska förutsättningar.
* Förmåga att koordinera arbete mellan verksamhet, utvecklingsteam och externa leverantörer.
* God teknisk förståelse för digitala plattformar, system och integrationer.


 Du har erfarenhet av att prioritera utvecklingsinitiativ och balansera verksamhetsbehov, kundvärde, tekniska förutsättningar och leveranskapacitet. Du kan koordinera arbetet mellan flera intressenter och skapa struktur och tydlighet i komplexa leveransmiljöer med beroenden mellan system, team och initiativ.
   

  

 Meriterande är erfarenhet från retail, konsultverksamhet eller liknande verksamhet med fokus på e-handel och omnikanalsförsäljning. Det är också meriterande med erfarenhet av betalplattformar, betallösningar, kunddatasystem och personaliseringsverktyg samt certifiering inom SAFe.
   

  

  

**Vi erbjuder...**
* Friskvårdsbidrag: 5000 kr per år.
* Personalrabatt: Förmånliga priser på många av våra produkter.
* Flexibla helgdagar: Möjlighet att byta arbetsfria helgdagar mot andra dagar på året.
* Förmånsportal (Benify): Erbjudanden inom bland annat kollektivtrafik, leasingbil, gym och hälsobehandlingar.
* Trygga försäkringar: Förstärkt föräldrapenning, tjänstepension (ITP) och kompletterande försäkringar.


**Om oss**
 Apoteket grundades 1971 och ägs av svenska staten, vilket innebär att vi arbetar både ansvarsfullt och långsiktigt. Vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag handlar om att förbättra människors hälsa, läkemedelsanvändning och bidra till ökad patientsäkerhet. Med omkring 400 apotek och 3000 medarbetare över hela landet har vi nära samarbete med hälso- och sjukvården – alltid med omtanke om både människor och miljö.
   

  

 Vårt mål är tydligt: Ett liv i hälsa, för alla.
   

  

  

**Praktisk information**
 Nyfiken? Det räcker gott.
   

  

 Hör av dig om rollen fångar ditt intresse! Vi berättar gärna mer om tjänsten och vår verksamhet – så du får en tydligare bild och kan avgöra om det känns helt rätt. Vänta bara inte för länge, urval och intervju sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
   

  

 Skicka ditt CV tillsammans med svar på våra urvalsfrågor. Du behöver inte skriva ett personligt brev – frågorna är utformade för att hjälpa oss förstå mer om dina erfarenheter och kompetenser för matchning mot tjänst.
   

  

 Vi använder tester för objektivt urval som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Provanställning tillämpas.
   

  

 Välkommen till Apoteket!

title: Head of Operational Excellence, Tieto Indtech
description:
**Job Description**
 Tieto Indtech is a software and data business serving industries where reliability, efficiency, and digital infrastructure are critical. Our solutions support public sector organizations, energy and utilities companies, industrial businesses, and information-intensive operations across the Nordics and beyond.
   

  

 As part of an ambitious transformation agenda, we are accelerating the adoption of AI, modern operating models, and continuous improvement practices across the business.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a Head of Operational Excellence to lead the transformation of how Multichannel & BIX operates.
   

  

 This is a senior cross-functional leadership role responsible for improving business performance through Lean principles, AI-enabled ways of working, strong governance, and operational discipline. Working closely with leaders across Product, Delivery, Technology, Support, and Security, you will build the operational foundation that enables the business to scale, execute strategy, and succeed in an AI-driven future.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and drive the Operational Excellence strategy across Multichannel & BIX.
* Lead AI-enabled transformation initiatives that improve productivity, quality, and decision-making.
* Simplify and standardize processes, governance, and ways of working across the organization.
* Strengthen performance management through clear KPIs, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.
* Establish scalable operating models that support growth, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure security, compliance, risk management, and governance are embedded in business operations.
* Build organizational capability in Lean, operational leadership, and continuous improvement.
* Support senior leaders in translating business strategy into measurable operational outcomes.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Faster and more efficient execution across the organization.
* Increased adoption of AI in core workflows and internal services.
* Stronger business performance through improved productivity and quality.
* Greater consistency through standardized processes and governance.
* Reduced operational risk and improved compliance.
* Clear performance visibility through meaningful KPIs and reporting.
* A culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.


**What We're Looking For**
 You bring a strong track record in operational excellence, business transformation, or large-scale change management within technology, software, or service-driven organizations.
   

  

**You likely have:**
* Experience leading Lean or operational transformation programmes.
* Proven success driving AI-enabled business improvement.
* Strong understanding of performance management, governance, and operating models.
* Experience working across multiple business functions and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Knowledge of risk, compliance, and operational management frameworks.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* A passion for building high-performing organizations and delivering measurable business impact.


**Why Join Us?**
 This is a unique opportunity to shape how a growing software business operates in the age of AI. You will work directly with senior leaders, influence company-wide transformation, and play a critical role in creating a more scalable, efficient, and future-ready organization.
   

  

**Application deadline: 15th of October, but we will process applications on an ongoing basis.**
 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
   

  

**Stay alert to recruitment scams:**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

title: Avdelningschef för IT- och verksamhetsprojektledning – Vattenfall Eldistribution AB
description:
*Vill du ha ett meningsfullt jobb där du får bidra till att göra verklig skillnad både för samhället och energiomställningen? Hos oss är du en del av en samhällsviktig verksamhet och får jobba med spännande projekt, teknik i framkant och kollegor som värdesätter varandra.*
 Vattenfall Eldistribution står mitt i energiomställningen och har en central roll i den kraftfulla elektrifiering som sker i samhället. Vi bygger framtidens elnät idag och driver en samhällsbärande infrastruktur som distribuerar drygt hälften av all el som produceras i Sverige.
   

  

 Vårt uppdrag är viktigt på riktigt – bli en del av Vattenfall Eldistribution!
   

  

 Nu söker vi en
 **avdelningschef för IT- och verksamhetsprojektledning** 
 – en nyckelroll i vår digitaliseringsresa och i arbetet för att Sverige ska nå sina klimatmål.
   

  

 Avdelningen IT- och verksamhetsprojektledare leder och levererar projekt inom IT-utveckling, digitalisering och verksamhetsutveckling. Avdelningen säkerställer tillgången av projektledarkompetens och ansvarar för att utveckla bolagets ramverk och modeller för verksamhetsutvecklingsprojekt.
   

  

 Digitaliseringstakten är hög, vilket innebär att avdelningen är involverad i många av de projekt som genomförs. Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens arbetssätt. Vi utvecklar våra agila förmågor samtidigt som vi pragmatiskt använder traditionella projektmetoder där de passar bäst.
   

  

**Som Chef För Avdelningen Kommer Du Att**
* Vara en nyckelperson i vår digitaliseringsresa, där avdelningen är en möjliggörare för genomförandet av bolagets strategi.
* Leda en avdelning med cirka 20 medarbetare, samt externa konsulter när behovet finns, som driver bolagets IT-, digitaliserings- och verksamhetsprojekt.
* Motivera och skapa engagemang hos dina medarbetare, samt ge dem rätt förutsättningar och mandat att nå gemensamma mål.
* Säkerställa att våra metoder och ramverk för att driva verksamhetsutvecklingsinitiativ är effektiva och används i verksamheten.
* Bygga starka relationer med interna och externa parter – din förmåga att kommunicera, samarbeta, påverka och utveckla verksamheten är avgörande.
* Rapportera till enhetschefen Director IT, och ingå i enhetens ledningsgrupp.


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi letar efter en ledare som kombinerar erfarenhet med nyfikenhet och driv. Du har en stabil grund och dokumenterad erfarenhet inom IT och projektledning, samt ett genuint intresse för hur digitala lösningar kan skapa värde för verksamheten.
   

  

**Vi Ser Gärna Att Du**
* Har ett coachande och strukturerat ledarskap där du skapar tydlighet, prioritering och framdrift. Du förbereder dig väl, fångar upp viktiga beslut och säkerställer att idéer och diskussioner omsätts till konkreta aktiviteter och resultat.
* Drivs av att utveckla både människor och arbetssätt och inspirerar dina medarbetare att växa och känna engagemang.
* Har ett starkt verksamhets- och kundfokus och ett genuint intresse för verksamheten – och ser IT som en möjliggörare för framgång.
* Har förståelse för kostnader, intäkter och effektivitet ur ett ekonomiskt perspektiv.
* Är kommunikativ, både skriftligt och muntligt, och kan skapa tydliga presentationer och rapporter på svenska och engelska.


 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har förmågan att snabbt omsätta dialog och beslut till konkreta planer, skapa tydlighet kring nästa steg och säkerställa att organisationen håller riktningen även när förutsättningarna förändras. Du behöver också kunna anpassa dig snabbt till nya och utmanande situationer och skapa trygghet för avdelningen genom förändringen.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter olika erfarenheter och perspektiv – det viktigaste är att du delar vår ambition att driva digitalisering och bidra till Sveriges energiomställning.
   

  

**Utöver Detta**
* Agerar du i linje med våra värderingar på Vattenfall – Open, Active, Positive och Safe – och inspirerar andra att göra detsamma.
* Arbetar du i enlighet med Vattenfalls LEADership-förväntningar genom att leda dig själv, utveckla och engagera medarbetare, skapa samarbete i team samt driva prestation och resultat.


 Ytterligare information
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en företagskultur där vi strävar efter att vara öppna, aktiva och positiva, med arbetsuppgifter som utvecklar och utmanar dig. Vi erbjuder ett fritt och stimulerande arbete där du blir en del av en stark gemenskap och tillsammans med ditt team hittar de bästa lösningarna för våra kunder och verksamheten. Vi har förmånen att vara med på resan när energibranschen ställer om. Det ställer krav på att du är anpassningsbar, men ger dig också stora möjligheter till både personlig och yrkesmässig utveckling. Vi uppmuntrar och stöttar kontinuerligt lärande, vilket behövs för att vi ska kunna anpassa oss till nya krav, förutsättningar och konsekvenser kopplade till ny teknik, nya regelverk och liknande.
   

  

 För oss på Vattenfall är det viktigt med en god balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Därför erbjuder vi flexibilitet i arbetet samt möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån vid behov. Vi erbjuder även flera andra personalförmåner, exempelvis arbetstidsförkortning, förmånliga tjänstepensionsavtal och föräldraledighetstillägg.  Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
   

  

**Placeringsort**
 Solna, Luleå eller Trollhättan
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten kontakta anställande chef Jessica Noack. jessica.noack@vattenfall.com
   

  

 För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Jessica Petersson, jessica.petersson@vattenfall.com
   

  

 Fackliga representanter för denna tjänst är Christian Ericsson, Ledarna, Anne-Marie Sjöbohm, Akademikerna, Jan-Olof Eriksson, Unionen, Ulf Tengman, SEKO. Alla kontaktpersoner nås via Vattenfalls växel 08-739 50 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 4 oktober 2026** 
 Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. Urval och intervjuer sker efter sista ansökningsdag. I den här rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester att förekomma.
   

  

*Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade och du kan komma att bli krigsplacerad. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.
   

  

 På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här.*
 Företagsbeskrivning
   

  

 Vattenfall Eldistribution AB är Vattenfalls elnätsverksamhet och ett av Sveriges största elnätsföretag. Vi ansvarar för en samhällsbärande infrastruktur som distribuerar el till mer än 900 000 företag och hushåll. Som medarbetare hos oss bidrar du varje dag till att samhället fungerar och till en säker elförsörjning för kommande generationer. Tillsammans bygger vi framtidens elnät och möjliggör omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta här

title: Teknisk systemförvaltare – ärendehantering & utskrift
description:
*Vill du arbeta med teknisk systemförvaltning på en myndighet med forskningsintensiv verksamhet inom försvars- och säkerhetsområdet där ditt arbete gör skillnad för Sverige?* 
**Då kan FOI vara din nya arbetsplats! Vi erbjuder ett arbetsliv i balans, en utvecklande arbetsmiljö och ett samhällsviktigt arbete!**
**Om tjänsten**
 Som Teknisk Systemförvaltare kommer du att fokusera främst på de tekniska aspekterna av systemförvaltning. Tjänsten innebär applikationsdrift och att ansvara för den tekniska miljön. Praktiskt arbete såsom konfiguration, felsökning och uppdatering av respektive system tillhör de dagliga uppgifterna.
   

  

 Systemen det handlar om är vårt ärende- och dokumenthanteringssystem Platina med tillhörande funktioner som hanterar våra verksamhetsprocesser inom dokumenthantering, rapportgranskning och inventering av handlingar. Det andra är vårt centrala skrivarsystem för administration av skrivare och kopiatorer.
   

  

 Som en del av förvaltningen kommer du även arbeta med planering av integrationer, vidareutveckling, omvärldsbevakning samt supportärenden. Vidare kommer du arbeta nära med funktionen som har hand om den underliggande infrastrukturen för systemen.
   

  

 I rollen som teknisk systemförvaltare kommer du att ingå i sektion systemförvaltning på IT-enheten.
   

  

  

**Om enheten**
 Du kommer att ingå i enheten Systemförvaltning som tillhör avdelningen. Läs mer o mvad vi gör här: Forskningsstöd.
   

  

  

**Har du den kompetensprofil vi behöver?**
**Krav**
* Aktuell eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT-området, gärna inom systemvetenskap,
* Några års erfarenhet av att administrera Windows Server,
* Erfarenhet av att skriva skript i Power Shell,
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift,
* B-körkort.


 För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du arbetar bra med komplexa frågor och har god förmåga att analysera och bryta ner problem i dess beståndsdelar. Du är självgående och har förmåga att driva ditt arbete framåt mot uppställda mål med goda resultat. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

  

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av arbete med centrala skrivarsystem,
* Erfarenhet av arbete med ärendehanteringssystem likt Platina eller motsvarande för myndighet eller kommun.


**Vad erbjuder vi dig?**
 Totalförsvarets forskningsinstitut (FOI) är en statlig myndighet som bedriver världsledande forskning inom försvar och säkerhet till stöd för Sveriges militära och civila försvar. Vi erbjuder en unik arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta med det som är viktigt för totalförsvaret och hela samhället. Forskningen tillämpas både inom försvarsmyndigheter och hos civila aktörer och spelar en avgörande roll i att bygga en relevant och effektiv försvarsförmåga.
   

  

 Vi arbetar medvetet för en god arbetsmiljö med en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Utöver detta erbjuder vi en rad förmåner. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss: https://www.foi.se/jobba-hos-oss.html
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

  

**Vill du vara med och söka svaren för en säkrare värld?**
 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV via ansökningsknappen senast den 14:e oktober!
   

  

 OBS! Vi har valt att avstå från personligt brev i denna rekryteringsprocess. Det är därför viktigt att du besvarar urvalsfrågorna, då dina svar utgör en del av underlaget i vår bedömning.
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Sektionschef Mathias Sarri. Fackliga företrädare är David Sundell (Saco-S) och Jonas Svefors (OFR/S – ST) Samtliga nås på 08-555 030 00.
   

  

 Då anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585). Inför säkerhetsprövning efterfrågas vidimerade kopior på de utbildningar och tjänstgöringsintyg som är relevanta för tjänsten.
   

  

 FOI är en myndighet varmed inlämnade ansökningshandlingar blir allmän handling som på begäran kan lämnas ut till utomstående enligt offentlighets- och sekretesslagen.
   

  

 Erbjudanden från rekryteringsföretag undanbedes.

title: Teknisk systemförvaltare inom fastighetsförvaltning och BIM / BLM till Akademiska Hus
description:
Vill du kombinera teknisk systemförståelse med verksamhetsnära utveckling i en roll där dina insatser får stor betydelse för hur Sveriges ledande kunskapsmiljöer förvaltas och utvecklas? Nu söker vi en teknisk systemförvaltare som vill ta ansvar för några av Akademiska Hus största och mest verksamhetskritiska system.
   

  

**Ditt uppdrag**
 Som teknisk systemförvaltare får du en nyckelroll i förvaltningen och utvecklingen av våra system inom fastighetsförvaltning och building lifecycle management (BLM). Du ansvarar för system som Faciliate och Geminus+ (tidigare Asset+), samt Geminus Bas (tidigare FM Access) och Solidworks PDM. Det är system som stödjer centrala delar av vår verksamhet inom fastighetsförvaltning och drift utav våra campusmiljöer samt digital informationsförvaltning.
   

  

 Du blir en viktig länk mellan verksamheten, IT-organisationen, drift- och systemleverantörer. Rollen innebär både operativt ansvar för stabil och säker systemdrift och ett utvecklingsorienterat uppdrag där du tillsammans med systemförvaltare och systemägare i verksamheten, driver förbättringar, prioriteringar och långsiktig utveckling av systemportföljen.
   

  

 Systemportföljen är komplex, med flera beroenden mellan systemen och kopplingar till andra delar av Akademiska Hus IT-miljö. Flera av systemen driftas huvudsakligen on-prem och tillhandahålls i olika användargränssnitt. Det gör rollen både tekniskt spännande och verksamhetsnära – med stora möjligheter att bidra till struktur, kvalitet och utveckling.
   

  

 Du ingår i vårt team för systemförvaltning och rapporterar till chefen för området. Rollen kan vara placerad på något av våra kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm eller Umeå.
   

  

**Det här får du arbeta med**
**I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att**
* vara rådgivare till verksamheten i hur IT kan utveckla arbetssätt, processer och informationsflöden
* bidra till en relevant, effektiv och långsiktigt hållbar systemportfölj
* prioritera, planera och följa upp utvecklings- och förvaltningsaktiviteter tillsammans med systemförvaltare
* driva och koordinera utvecklingsarbete, bland annat genom kravställning mot leverantörer, driftorganisation och interna IT-specialister
* delta i planering och genomförande av förändringar, uppgraderingar och tester
* ansvara för tekniska support- och incidentärenden inom dina system
* skapa och underhålla teknisk dokumentation
* säkerställa att systemen uppfyller våra krav på säkerhet, kontinuitet, backup, redundans, behörighetshantering och regelefterlevnad


**En roll i förändring och utveckling**
 Akademiska Hus befinner sig i ett större förändringsarbete där driftorganisationen rör sig mot en mer objektbaserad förvaltning. Som teknisk systemförvaltare kommer du att ha en viktig roll i detta arbete – både genom din tekniska förståelse och genom din förmåga att omsätta verksamhetens behov till hållbara IT-lösningar.
   

  

 Vi ser också potential för nära samarbete med teknisk systemförvaltning inom fastighetsautomation och andra fastighetsnära system. Det innebär att du får möjlighet att bidra till helhetssyn, kunskapsdelning och utveckling över portföljgränserna.
   

  

**Ditt bidrag**
 Vi söker dig som är tekniskt trygg, nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med god förståelse för hur IT skapar värde i verksamheten. Du trivs med att växla mellan tekniska frågor, verksamhetsdialog och strukturerat förvaltningsarbete. Som person är du relationsskapande, strukturerad och ansvarstagande. Du driver arbetet framåt och skapar goda samarbeten med verksamhet, IT och externa leverantörer.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:
   

  

* mycket god teknisk och IT-relaterad kompetens, med förmåga att förstå systemarkitektur, integrationer och dataflöden
* förmåga att problem- och felsöka samt kravställa mot driftorganisation och systemleverantörer
* god verksamhetsförståelse, med bakgrund inom fastighetsförvaltning
* förståelse för fastighetssystem och hur de används i den dagliga verksamheten
* eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller annan relevant utbildning
* förmåga att driva arbetet inom ditt ansvarsområde och leda mindre IT-relaterade projekt
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift.


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Även Har**
* Erfarenhet av objektorienterad fastighetsförvaltning med stöd av BIM
* Erfarenhet av Faciliate, Geminus+ (tidigare Asset+), Geminus Bas (tidigare FM Access) eller Solidworks PDM


**Vi erbjuder**
 På Akademiska Hus blir du välkomnad in i en kunskapsstark organisation med vänlig kultur, tydligt samhällsuppdrag och spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter. Här får du bidra till attraktiva, hållbara och framtidssäkra miljöer för utbildning, forskning och innovation – och samtidigt utvecklas tillsammans med kompetenta kollegor över hela landet.
   

  

 Akademiska Hus är ett av Sveriges största fastighetsbolag. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar lokaler för högskolor och universitet och skapar förutsättningar för världsledande utbildning och forskning. Genom att även erbjuda labb och kontor för företag blir våra campus mer innovativa och hållbara platser, som främjar samverkan, kunskapsutveckling och kreativitet. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare och ser till att de växer.
   

  

 Vill du veta mer om oss – ta en titt på vår FILM.
   

  

**Nyfiken?** 
  

  

 Känns detta som en möjlighet för dig, ta chansen och sök nu! Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande, med sista ansökningsdag 18/10.
   

  

 I denna rekrytering samarbetar Akademiska Hus med Randstad. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Marie Lithander Marcus (marie.lithandermarcus@akademiskahus.se), Chef systemförvaltning eller ansvarig rekryteringskonsult på Randstad, Erik Perborn(erik.perborn@randstad.se).
   

  

 Bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras på slutkandidater.
   

  

 Välkommen till en arbetsplats där dina idéer och initiativ värdesätts och där du kan vara med och forma framtiden!

title: Director | Strategy&

title: SCADA Automation control Engineer
description:
**Role description**  

Automation Controls Engineer


### **Role Summary**



Hands-on Automation Controls Engineer responsible for the day-to-day operational technology (OT) control layer on the shop floor, including PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems across Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) process areas.



The role will work under the Sweden Engineering and Automation Head, supporting the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and ongoing reliability of process equipment within a GMP-regulated manufacturing environment.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**1. PLC, SCADA & HMI Engineering**


* Configure, test, and maintain PLC and SCADA systems for process skids, utilities, and packaging lines.
* Work with Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000, or equivalent platforms.
* Perform ladder/structured-text logic changes, I/O commissioning, loop tuning, and HMI screen updates.
* Execute changes in accordance with formal change-control processes.


**2. Installation & Commissioning**


* Support the installation and commissioning of new process equipment.
* Participate in FAT/SAT (Factory Acceptance Testing/Site Acceptance Testing).
* Write and execute IQ/OQ (Installation Qualification/Operational Qualification) test scripts.
* Verify instrumentation and field wiring.
* Work with system integrators and site engineering teams to bring equipment to a validated, production-ready state.


**3. Shop-Floor Automation Support**


* Provide first-line automation support for manufacturing operations.
* Troubleshoot control faults, alarms, and interlocks.
* Work with operators and maintenance teams to identify and resolve automation-related issues.
* Conduct root-cause investigations for automation-related deviations.
* Document troubleshooting activities, corrective actions, and fixes in accordance with the quality system.


**4. OT Data & Connectivity**


* Maintain plant OT data and connectivity infrastructure.
* Support historian tags, OPC UA/Modbus connections, and SCADA-to-L2/MES/batch interfaces.
* Ensure reliable flow of batch records and process data.
* Support the foundational OT architecture required for future IIoT and analytics initiatives.


**5. OT Compliance, Reliability & Cybersecurity**


* Maintain backups, software versions, and user access for controllers and OT servers.
* Ensure systems are maintained in line with GAMP 5 and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
* Follow basic OT cybersecurity practices, including IEC 62443 principles and network segregation.
* Monitor hardware obsolescence and contribute to the site's automation and OT upgrade plans.

### **Required Skills & Experience**


* Hands-on experience in industrial automation and controls engineering.
* Strong experience with PLC, SCADA, and HMI systems.
* Experience with **Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000**.
* Experience with PLC programming, I/O commissioning, instrumentation, and control systems troubleshooting.
* Experience with FAT/SAT and IQ/OQ in a regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience working in **GMP/GxP environments**, preferably within pharmaceutical or life sciences manufacturing.
* Knowledge of SCADA, historians, OPC UA/Modbus, MES, and batch interfaces.
* Understanding of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, and OT cybersecurity principles.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

title: Fullstack Product Engineer
description:
Intric builds a sovereign AI platform for organisations that need to keep their data close: public-sector bodies, municipalities and critical infrastructure. It’s a small team, which means the work is real, the decisions matter and you’ll get close to the systems that actually keep the product running.


We are looking for a Full Stack Product Engineer to take direct ownership across our product surface. You will step into a fast-moving engineering setting with high autonomy, working across frontend interfaces, backend logic, and deployment to ship practical solutions directly to users. Our core stack is Python and Svelte, though prior experience with these specific technologies is not required.

**What you'll do**

* **Own end-to-end product features.** You work directly with Product to turn user feedback into working software, building across frontend interfaces, backend services, and deployment pipelines.
* **Shorten user feedback loops.** You maintain a steady release cadence, shipping frequent improvements and resolving issues without waiting for specialist handoffs.
* **Orchestrate parallel development workflows.** You use AI coding agents to explore edge cases, draft tests, and scaffold changes concurrently, multiplying what you can ship.
* **Choose simple solutions over complex systems.** You focus on solving user problems quickly, whether by making a direct update or integrating an existing tool, rather than overengineering the backend.
* **Anchor system reliability.** You step into unfamiliar or undocumented areas of the codebase with confidence, making safe updates and keeping the product stable as the team grows.

**Who you are**

* **You focus on user outcomes.** You care about whether an update genuinely helps the user, rather than just writing clean syntax.
* **You navigate the full stack.** You are comfortable working across modern web technologies, tracing an issue through the application layer to the database or build pipeline.
* **You manage parallel work with AI agents.** You keep multiple tasks moving at once by delegating to coding tools, and you bring the technical discipline to spot mistakes or bad assumptions in generated code.
* **You bring good design taste.** You care about how software feels in practice. You notice awkward interactions, rough spacing, and confusing flows.
* **You explore without a roadmap.** You treat ambiguous code and sparse documentation as an invitation to investigate, read source logic, and map safe paths forward.
* **You balance speed with discipline.** You know when a simple fix is sufficient and when a system change demands deeper testing and verification.

**Why join**


You will have broad technical ownership across a product where engineering choices shape the roadmap. Intric operates in high-trust sectors where data sovereignty matters, giving you the opportunity to solve real product problems without bureaucratic delays.

**About Intric**


Europe's public sector is facing its biggest challenge in generations. A shrinking workforce must deliver more services to more people, and the gap grows every year. Intric exists to close it. We bring modern AI to the organisations that keep society running, and in doing so, we're defining how public services will work for decades to come.


We value ownership, high standards, and thoughtful execution. Titles matter less than contribution. If you see something that can be improved, you take initiative. If something is unclear, you ask questions. If a customer faces a challenge, you lean in.


We combine ambition with collaboration. We move fast, but we care deeply about doing things right. As we continue scaling across Europe, every team member plays a meaningful role in shaping both the company and the culture.

title: REXUS/BEXUS Program Manager – Payloads & Flight Systems
description:
**Description**
---------------


Welcome to SSC Space, where people, technology and space come together.
  

Formerly known as Swedish Space Corporation, SSC Space is a Swedish space company with an international reach. We work with space organisations, research institutes, institutional customers and commercial partners, providing specialist expertise across satellite communications, spacecraft consultancy, rocket and balloon systems, and other space-related services.
  

The REXUS/BEXUS program gives university students from across Europe the opportunity to design and conduct scientific and technological experiments on sounding rockets and stratospheric balloons. Each year, two rockets and two balloons are launched from Esrange Space Center in northern Sweden, carrying experiments developed by student teams.
  

  

We are now looking for a REXUS/BEXUS Program Manager to join our Payloads & Flight Systems team. Working alongside the current program manager, you will combine technical reviews, international collaboration and hands-on campaign activities. You will support student teams throughout their projects and help ensure that their experiments are ready for integration, testing and launch.
  

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the next generation of engineers and scientists while taking part in international rocket and balloon campaigns.
**Requirements**
----------------


**We are looking for someone who:**
* Holds a master’s degree in engineering or has an equivalent technical background.
* Has a good understanding of electrical or software design and engineering.
* Is organized and comfortable coordinating several activities and stakeholders.
* Communicates clearly and enjoys supporting and guiding others.
* Can work independently while collaborating with students, colleagues and international partners.
* Is fluent in spoken and written English.
* Enjoys combining office-based work with practical, hands-on activities.
* Is willing and able to travel regularly within Europe, including during the summer.

  

Previous involvement in REXUS/BEXUS or another hands-on student, research or educational program is an advantage.
**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**Together with the current program manager, you will:**
  

* Participate in the selection of student experiments and conduct key technical reviews, including Preliminary Design Reviews and Critical Design Reviews.
* Review the electrical and software aspects of the student teams’ experiments.
* Conduct Integration Progress Reviews and Acceptance Reviews at universities across Europe.
* Guide student teams and help them develop experiments that are safe and ready for integration, testing and launch.
* Act as Payload Manager during REXUS and BEXUS launch campaigns at Esrange Space Center.
* Coordinate experiment readiness with the Esrange campaign manager and the wider campaign organization.
* Participate in integration and functional testing activities in Germany for the REXUS campaigns.
* Collaborate closely with the program partners: SNSA, DLR, ESA, ZARM, DLR MORABA and SSC Space.
* Support proposals for future program funding cycles and contribute to managing SSC Space’s program budget.
**Benefits**
------------


**We offer you**
  

* The opportunity to co-manage one of Europe’s leading student rocket and balloon programs.
* A varied role combining technical work, project coordination, education and launch activities.
* The chance to work with students and partner organizations from across Europe.
* First-hand experience of sounding rocket and stratospheric balloon launches at Esrange Space Center.
* An international working environment based in either Stockholm or Kiruna.

  

**Additional benefits**
  

* In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
* Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.

  

**Location**
  

This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.
  

  

**Further information**  

For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:
  

Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com
  

Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com
  

  

**Next Step**  

If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.
